title: Missing installed module
example_error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'requests'
explanation: The active interpreter cannot find the requested module.
likely_cause: The package is absent from this environment, or pip installed it into another interpreter.
fix: Activate your virtual environment and run python -m pip install requests. Check python -m pip --version points to that environment.

title: Missing dictionary key
example_error: KeyError: 'username'
explanation: A dictionary lookup requested a key that is not present.
likely_cause: Input data omitted the key or uses different spelling.
fix: Inspect data.keys(). Validate required keys first, or use data.get('username') when missing values are acceptable.

title: Index outside a list
example_error: IndexError: list index out of range
explanation: The requested position is outside the list boundaries.
likely_cause: The list is empty or the index equals its length.
fix: Check the list length before indexing. Prefer iteration over manually incrementing an index.

title: Adding text and numbers
example_error: TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'int' and 'str'
explanation: Python cannot add an integer directly to a string.
likely_cause: A value read from input remains text.
fix: Use int(value) for arithmetic after validation, or str(number) for text concatenation.

title: Invalid integer text
example_error: ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'abc'
explanation: The text is not a valid integer representation.
likely_cause: Input contains letters, a decimal point, or an empty string.
fix: Validate the input and handle ValueError. For a decimal quantity use an appropriate decimal or float parser.

title: Attribute accessed on None
example_error: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'split'
explanation: An attribute was requested from None.
likely_cause: A lookup returned no value, or a function omitted its return statement.
fix: Trace where the value is assigned. Handle None explicitly and ensure the producing function returns the expected object.

title: Undefined variable
example_error: NameError: name 'total' is not defined
explanation: The variable name is unavailable in the current scope.
likely_cause: There is a spelling mismatch or assignment has not executed.
fix: Use consistent spelling and initialize the variable on every code path before reading it.

title: Missing indented block
example_error: IndentationError: expected an indented block after 'if' statement
explanation: A compound statement needs an indented body.
likely_cause: The next statement is aligned with its parent or the body is empty.
fix: Indent the body consistently with four spaces. Use pass only when an intentionally empty body is needed.

title: Mixed tabs and spaces
example_error: TabError: inconsistent use of tabs and spaces in indentation
explanation: Indentation mixes incompatible whitespace.
likely_cause: Code was pasted from editors using different indentation settings.
fix: Convert indentation to spaces throughout the affected block and enable visible whitespace in your editor.

title: Missing colon
example_error: SyntaxError: expected ':'
explanation: The parser expected the colon that starts a block.
likely_cause: An if, for, while, def, or class header is incomplete.
fix: Add the colon at the end of the header and indent its body. Inspect the preceding line too.

title: Missing local file
example_error: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'data.csv'
explanation: The path does not resolve to an existing file.
likely_cause: A relative path is being resolved from a different working directory.
fix: Inspect Path.cwd() and verify the filename. Resolve bundled files relative to __file__ when appropriate.

title: File permission denied
example_error: PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: 'report.csv'
explanation: The operating system refused the requested file access.
likely_cause: The file is locked, the path is a directory, or the user lacks write access.
fix: Close applications holding the file and choose a writable file path. Check permissions without broadly elevating the whole process.

title: Division by zero
example_error: ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
explanation: The denominator evaluates to zero.
likely_cause: An empty count or unvalidated input is used as a divisor.
fix: Check the denominator and define explicit behavior for zero, such as returning no result or reporting invalid input.

title: Unbounded recursion
example_error: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded
explanation: Nested function calls exhausted the recursion limit.
likely_cause: The base case is missing or recursive input does not get smaller.
fix: Fix the stopping condition and verify progress toward it. Use an iterative approach for deeply nested workloads.

title: Wrong unpacking size
example_error: ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 2)
explanation: The iterable produces more values than the assignment has targets.
likely_cause: A record shape changed or dictionary iteration was mistaken for key-value pairs.
fix: Inspect the iterable. Use dictionary.items() for pairs or a starred target when extra values are intentional.

title: Circular import
example_error: ImportError: cannot import name 'User' from partially initialized module 'models' (most likely due to a circular import)
explanation: Two modules depend on each other before initialization finishes.
likely_cause: Top-level imports form a cycle.
fix: Move shared types into a third module or reorganize dependencies. A local import can help when the dependency is only needed during a call.

title: Missing DataFrame column
example_error: KeyError: 'customer_id' in DataFrame columns
explanation: The requested label is absent from the DataFrame.
likely_cause: CSV headers contain whitespace, a different case, or a different column name.
fix: Inspect df.columns.tolist(). Rename or strip headers deliberately, then select an existing column.

title: Ambiguous Series truth
example_error: ValueError: The truth value of a Series is ambiguous
explanation: A Series contains multiple truth values and cannot be one boolean automatically.
likely_cause: A Series was used in if, or Python and/or was used between masks.
fix: Use .any() or .all() for a single decision. Combine elementwise masks with & or | and parenthesize each condition.

title: Chained assignment
example_error: SettingWithCopyWarning: A value is trying to be set on a copy of a slice from a DataFrame
explanation: An assignment through an intermediate slice may not update the original frame.
likely_cause: Chained indexing makes the target ambiguous; behavior and warnings depend on the pandas version.
fix: Assign once with df.loc[mask, 'column'] = value. Use .copy() if you want an independent subset.

title: String accessor on numeric data
example_error: AttributeError: Can only use .str accessor with string values!
explanation: The selected Series does not have suitable string data.
likely_cause: A column was inferred as numeric or contains unexpected types.
fix: Inspect the dtype. Convert intentional text using astype('string') before applying .str methods, preserving missing values.

title: Mismatched assignment length
example_error: ValueError: Length of values (3) does not match length of index (4)
explanation: The new column has a different number of values than rows.
likely_cause: Filtering changed the row count or a generated list is too short.
fix: Generate one value per row, assign a scalar for repetition, or use an indexed Series when label alignment is intended.

title: CSV field count mismatch
example_error: pandas.errors.ParserError: Error tokenizing data. C error: Expected 3 fields in line 5, saw 4
explanation: A CSV row splits into an unexpected number of fields.
likely_cause: The delimiter is wrong or embedded delimiters are not properly quoted.
fix: Inspect the affected row and configure sep and quotechar correctly. Repair malformed data before considering skipped rows.

title: Merging incompatible key types
example_error: ValueError: You are trying to merge on int64 and object columns for key 'id'
explanation: The join columns use incompatible representations.
likely_cause: One file reads identifiers as numbers while another preserves them as text.
fix: Inspect both key dtypes and convert to a common intentional type. Preserve leading zeros when identifiers are textual.

title: Removed DataFrame append
example_error: AttributeError: 'DataFrame' object has no attribute 'append'
explanation: Recent pandas releases no longer provide DataFrame.append.
likely_cause: Older code uses an API removed in pandas 2.0.
fix: Collect frames and call pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True). Avoid repeatedly concatenating individual rows in a loop.

title: Missing values cannot become integers
example_error: pandas.errors.IntCastingNaNError: Cannot convert non-finite values (NA or inf) to integer
explanation: A standard integer dtype cannot represent missing or infinite values.
likely_cause: A numeric column contains NaN or infinity before astype(int).
fix: Use nullable Int64 for missing integers and handle infinity explicitly. Fill missing values only when that replacement is meaningful.

title: Datetime format mismatch
example_error: ValueError: time data '31/12/2025' doesn't match format '%m/%d/%Y'
explanation: The date text does not follow the selected format.
likely_cause: Day and month order differ from the parser configuration.
fix: Pass the correct format to pd.to_datetime. If using errors='coerce', inspect resulting NaT values instead of silently ignoring failures.

title: No compatible distribution
example_error: ERROR: No matching distribution found for example-package
explanation: pip found no installable distribution for the requested requirement.
likely_cause: The name or version is wrong, the Python version is unsupported, or the configured index lacks the package.
fix: Check the project name, supported Python versions, and index URL. Choose a supported version and interpreter.

title: Dependency resolution conflict
example_error: ERROR: ResolutionImpossible: conflicting dependencies
explanation: The requested versions cannot satisfy all dependency constraints together.
likely_cause: Pinned packages require incompatible versions of a shared dependency.
fix: Read the conflict details and choose compatible top-level versions. Rebuild a clean virtual environment after updating the constraints.

title: Externally managed environment
example_error: error: externally-managed-environment
explanation: The operating system marks this Python installation as managed by its package tools.
likely_cause: pip is attempting to change system-managed packages.
fix: Create a virtual environment with python -m venv .venv and install there. Use pipx for isolated command-line applications.

title: Certificate verification failure
example_error: SSLError: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED certificate verify failed
explanation: pip cannot verify the package server certificate chain.
likely_cause: A corporate proxy certificate is missing, the clock is wrong, or the trust store is outdated.
fix: Check system time and configure the approved certificate bundle with your administrator. Keep TLS verification enabled.

title: Wheel build failed
example_error: ERROR: Failed building wheel for package
explanation: A package could not be compiled into an installable wheel.
likely_cause: No prebuilt wheel matches the interpreter, or build tools and native headers are missing.
fix: Read the first compiler error. Prefer a supported interpreter with published wheels, or install the package's documented build prerequisites.

title: pip command missing
example_error: pip: command not found
explanation: The shell cannot locate a pip executable.
likely_cause: The executable directory is absent from PATH or pip is not installed for this interpreter.
fix: Try python -m pip --version. Activate the environment, or use python -m ensurepip when supported by your Python installation.

title: Package download timed out
example_error: ReadTimeoutError: HTTPSConnectionPool read timed out while downloading
explanation: The package transfer exceeded the network timeout.
likely_cause: The network, proxy, or package index is slow or unavailable.
fix: Verify connectivity and proxy configuration, then retry. A longer pip --timeout can help slow connections without changing package sources.

title: Missing request body field
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Field required loc body name
explanation: The request does not contain a field required by the request model.
likely_cause: The JSON key is absent or data was sent as form content instead of JSON.
fix: Send a JSON object with the required fields and Content-Type application/json. Compare it with the schema in /docs.

title: Invalid integer parameter
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Input should be a valid integer loc path item_id
explanation: A path or query value cannot be parsed as the declared integer type.
likely_cause: A client sent a nonnumeric identifier to an integer parameter.
fix: Send an integer value or change the endpoint annotation if identifiers are intentionally strings.

title: Response model mismatch
example_error: fastapi.exceptions.ResponseValidationError: response field required
explanation: The handler's returned value does not match its response model.
likely_cause: A required field is missing, has the wrong type, or is nested differently.
fix: Compare every return path with response_model. Return validated data with all required fields and test empty and error cases.

title: Browser CORS blocked
example_error: Access to fetch has been blocked by CORS policy: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
explanation: The browser cannot expose a cross-origin API response to the frontend.
likely_cause: The frontend origin is not allowed or the preflight response lacks required headers.
fix: Add CORSMiddleware with the exact frontend scheme and host. Allow the required methods and headers and test the OPTIONS preflight.

title: ASGI module cannot import
example_error: ERROR: Error loading ASGI app. Could not import module 'main'
explanation: The server cannot import the module in its application target.
likely_cause: The launch directory is wrong, the module path is wrong, or an import inside the module fails.
fix: Run from the project root with the correct module:app target. Import the module directly to reveal underlying exceptions.

title: Coroutine returned without awaiting
example_error: TypeError: 'coroutine' object is not iterable
explanation: An unresolved coroutine reached response serialization.
likely_cause: An async helper was called without await.
fix: Make the route async and await the helper before returning its result. Keep blocking work out of the event loop.

title: Multipart dependency missing
example_error: RuntimeError: Form data requires "python-multipart" to be installed
explanation: Form or file parameters require the multipart parser.
likely_cause: python-multipart is absent from the environment running the API.
fix: Install python-multipart in the API environment, pin it in dependencies, and restart the server.

title: Local variable read too early
example_error: UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable 'count' where it is not associated with a value
explanation: A local name is read before assignment.
likely_cause: Assignment inside the function shadows an outer variable.
fix: Initialize count before branching or pass the value as an argument and return the update.

title: Wrong number of function arguments
example_error: TypeError: calculate() missing 1 required positional argument: 'price'
explanation: The call omits a required parameter.
likely_cause: The caller and function signature disagree.
fix: Inspect the signature and supply price explicitly, or define a meaningful default if it is optional.

title: Unexpected keyword argument
example_error: TypeError: calculate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount'
explanation: The function does not accept this named argument.
likely_cause: A parameter was renamed or the wrong API version is installed.
fix: Compare the installed function signature with the call and use a supported parameter name.

title: Argument passed twice
example_error: TypeError: calculate() got multiple values for argument 'price'
explanation: One parameter receives both positional and keyword values.
likely_cause: A keyword duplicates a positional argument or self is missing on a method.
fix: Supply each parameter once and ensure instance methods declare self first.

title: Integer used as a function
example_error: TypeError: 'int' object is not callable
explanation: Parentheses try to call a number.
likely_cause: A function name such as sum was reassigned to an integer.
fix: Rename the variable and restore the original function binding; use multiplication explicitly when intended.

title: List used as a function
example_error: TypeError: 'list' object is not callable
explanation: Parentheses attempt to call a list.
likely_cause: Square brackets were intended or the list builtin was shadowed.
fix: Use items[index] for indexing and avoid naming variables list.

title: None used as a subscript
example_error: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
explanation: Indexing was attempted on None.
likely_cause: A function returned nothing, often after an in-place list operation.
fix: Do not assign the result of list.sort(); use sorted(items) when a returned list is needed and handle absent values.

title: Integer cannot be iterated
example_error: TypeError: 'int' object is not iterable
explanation: An operation expects a collection but receives one integer.
likely_cause: A loop or list constructor received a count rather than a sequence.
fix: Use range(count) to iterate positions, or wrap the number in a list if it represents one item.

title: Unhashable list key
example_error: TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'
explanation: Dictionary keys and set members must be hashable.
likely_cause: A mutable list is used as a key or set member.
fix: Use a tuple of hashable values for a fixed sequence key, or reconsider the data structure.

title: Unhashable dictionary member
example_error: TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict'
explanation: A dictionary cannot itself be a set member or dictionary key.
likely_cause: A record was inserted where a stable identifier was expected.
fix: Use the record's immutable identifier; for deduplication compare selected field tuples.

title: Mutating a tuple
example_error: TypeError: 'tuple' object does not support item assignment
explanation: Tuples cannot change individual elements.
likely_cause: Code treats an immutable sequence like a list.
fix: Create a new tuple with the replacement or use a list when mutation is required.

title: Comparing text with numbers
example_error: TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of 'str' and 'int'
explanation: The operands do not share an ordering.
likely_cause: Input text is compared to a numeric threshold.
fix: Validate and parse the text into a numeric type before comparing.

title: String join includes a number
example_error: TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, int found
explanation: str.join requires every element to be text.
likely_cause: The sequence includes integers or other objects.
fix: Convert intentional display values with str before joining, and handle missing values explicitly.

title: Bytes and text combined
example_error: TypeError: can't concat str to bytes
explanation: Binary data and Unicode text are different types.
likely_cause: A file or network API returns bytes while code appends text.
fix: Decode bytes with the correct encoding for text work, or encode the text for a binary protocol.

title: Invalid UTF-8 input
example_error: UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xff in position 0: invalid start byte
explanation: The byte sequence is not valid under the selected encoding.
likely_cause: The file uses another encoding or is a binary format.
fix: Identify the actual format and encoding before reading. Use the corresponding decoder instead of silently discarding bytes.

title: Text cannot be encoded
example_error: UnicodeEncodeError: 'ascii' codec can't encode character '\u20ac'
explanation: The output encoding cannot represent the character.
likely_cause: An ASCII stream receives non-ASCII text.
fix: Write text with encoding='utf-8' where supported or configure the consumer's expected encoding.

title: Malformed JSON
example_error: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes
explanation: The JSON parser encountered invalid JSON syntax.
likely_cause: Input uses single quotes, a trailing comma, or an unquoted key.
fix: Produce JSON with json.dumps and inspect the failing location; Python dictionary literals are not JSON.

title: Empty JSON response
example_error: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
explanation: There is no valid JSON value at the beginning of the input.
likely_cause: The response is empty or contains an HTML error page.
fix: Check status, Content-Type, and body before calling response.json(); handle no-content responses separately.

title: Object cannot be JSON serialized
example_error: TypeError: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable
explanation: The standard JSON encoder does not encode this object directly.
likely_cause: A datetime is included in a dictionary passed to json.dumps.
fix: Convert the datetime to an ISO 8601 string or provide a deliberate serializer for that type.

title: Invalid regular expression
example_error: re.error: unterminated character set at position 0
explanation: The pattern opens a bracket expression without closing it.
likely_cause: A literal bracket was inserted as regex syntax.
fix: Close the character class, or use re.escape for user-provided text that should match literally.

title: Named regex group missing
example_error: IndexError: no such group
explanation: A match object does not contain the requested group.
likely_cause: The pattern and group name used by the caller differ.
fix: Inspect the compiled pattern's groupindex and use a declared capture group.

title: No regex match
example_error: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'group'
explanation: The regex search returned None.
likely_cause: The input does not match the pattern.
fix: Store the match result and check it is not None before accessing group().

title: Directory opened as a file
example_error: IsADirectoryError: [Errno 21] Is a directory
explanation: A file operation targeted a directory.
likely_cause: The path ends at a folder instead of a filename.
fix: Construct the full file path and check Path.is_file() when validating input.

title: File used as a directory
example_error: NotADirectoryError: [Errno 20] Not a directory
explanation: A path component expected to be a folder is a file.
likely_cause: Code appends a child filename to an existing regular file.
fix: Inspect each parent path and correct the directory location before creating children.

title: Directory already exists
example_error: FileExistsError: [Errno 17] File exists
explanation: Exclusive creation encountered an existing path.
likely_cause: Repeated runs create the same directory without allowing reuse.
fix: Use Path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) when reusing a directory is intended; otherwise choose a unique path.

title: Closed file operation
example_error: ValueError: I/O operation on closed file
explanation: The file handle has already been closed.
likely_cause: A handle escaped a with block or was explicitly closed earlier.
fix: Complete reading or writing inside the with block, or reopen the file for a later operation.

title: Disk full
example_error: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device
explanation: The destination cannot accept more data.
likely_cause: The disk or storage quota is exhausted.
fix: Check available space and quotas, remove only unneeded files, or write to a destination with sufficient capacity.

title: Too many open files
example_error: OSError: [Errno 24] Too many open files
explanation: The process exceeded its file descriptor limit.
likely_cause: Files or sockets are leaked or concurrency is excessive.
fix: Use context managers and close connections; bound concurrency before considering an operating-system limit change.

title: Broken pipe
example_error: BrokenPipeError: [Errno 32] Broken pipe
explanation: The other end of a pipe or socket closed before the write.
likely_cause: A consumer exited early or the connection dropped.
fix: Handle the disconnect and stop writing; inspect why the consumer closed and retry only when the operation is safe.

title: Connection refused
example_error: ConnectionRefusedError: [Errno 111] Connection refused
explanation: The target host actively rejected the connection.
likely_cause: No service is listening on the specified port or it is bound to another interface.
fix: Check the service is running and verify the host, port, and bind address.

title: Connection reset
example_error: ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer
explanation: The remote side forcibly closed an established connection.
likely_cause: The server restarted, a proxy terminated the request, or a timeout occurred.
fix: Inspect server and proxy limits and use bounded retries only for idempotent operations.

title: Socket operation timed out
example_error: TimeoutError: timed out
explanation: The operation did not finish within its deadline.
likely_cause: The remote endpoint is slow or unreachable.
fix: Set explicit connect and read timeouts and diagnose connectivity before increasing them.

title: Address already in use
example_error: OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use
explanation: A server cannot bind an occupied address.
likely_cause: Another process already listens on the selected port.
fix: Identify the listener, stop the intended old server, or select a free port.

title: Subprocess command failed
example_error: subprocess.CalledProcessError: Command returned non-zero exit status 1
explanation: A subprocess launched successfully but reported failure.
likely_cause: The external program rejected input or encountered its own error.
fix: Inspect captured stderr and the command's documented exit codes. Fix the underlying input instead of suppressing check=True.

title: Subprocess timeout
example_error: subprocess.TimeoutExpired: Command timed out after 10 seconds
explanation: The child process exceeded the configured timeout.
likely_cause: The program is blocked or requires longer than expected.
fix: Inspect whether it is waiting for input and choose an appropriate timeout; ensure child processes are cleaned up.

title: Lambda cannot be pickled
example_error: AttributeError: Can't pickle local object '<lambda>'
explanation: The serializer cannot locate an importable function definition.
likely_cause: A lambda or nested function is sent to multiprocessing or joblib.
fix: Move the callable to a named function at module scope and pass serializable arguments.

title: Multiprocessing bootstrap error
example_error: RuntimeError: An attempt has been made to start a new process before the current process has finished its bootstrapping phase
explanation: A spawned child imports code that starts another process immediately.
likely_cause: Process creation runs at module import on a spawn-based platform.
fix: Place process creation under if __name__ == '__main__': and keep worker functions importable.

title: Event loop already running
example_error: RuntimeError: asyncio.run() cannot be called from a running event loop
explanation: asyncio.run tries to create a loop inside an active loop.
likely_cause: Notebook or async application code calls the top-level runner.
fix: Await the coroutine directly within async code; reserve asyncio.run for the synchronous program entrypoint.

title: No running event loop
example_error: RuntimeError: no running event loop
explanation: An async scheduling API needs an active event loop.
likely_cause: create_task is called from synchronous initialization.
fix: Create tasks inside an async function running in the loop, and keep references to tasks that need lifecycle management.

title: Coroutine never awaited
example_error: RuntimeWarning: coroutine 'fetch' was never awaited
explanation: Calling an async function created a coroutine that was never executed.
likely_cause: The call omitted await or an appropriate task scheduling operation.
fix: Await fetch() inside async code, or run it through the application's event-loop entrypoint.

title: Dictionary changed during iteration
example_error: RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration
explanation: Keys were added or removed while a live dictionary iterator was active.
likely_cause: A loop deletes entries directly from the same dictionary.
fix: Iterate over a snapshot of keys or collect changes and apply them after the loop.

title: Iterator exhausted
example_error: StopIteration
explanation: The iterator has no next item.
likely_cause: next() was called after exhaustion without a default.
fix: Use next(iterator, default) if absence is expected or iterate with a for loop.

title: Assertion failed
example_error: AssertionError
explanation: An asserted condition evaluated to false.
likely_cause: An internal assumption does not hold for the current input.
fix: Inspect the condition and intermediate values. Use explicit exceptions for required runtime validation since assertions may be disabled.

title: Memory allocation failed
example_error: MemoryError
explanation: The interpreter could not allocate the requested memory.
likely_cause: The program materializes a very large collection or keeps growing references.
fix: Process data in chunks, stream results, and measure retained objects before increasing available memory.

title: Numeric overflow in math
example_error: OverflowError: math range error
explanation: The mathematical result exceeds the supported numeric range.
likely_cause: An exponential or another rapidly growing operation receives a large argument.
fix: Check input ranges and use numerically stable formulations such as logarithmic calculations.

title: Invalid mathematical domain
example_error: ValueError: math domain error
explanation: The input lies outside the real-valued function's domain.
likely_cause: Code computes a square root of a negative number or logarithm of a nonpositive value.
fix: Validate the input domain; use complex-number functions only when complex results are intended.

title: NaN cannot become an integer
example_error: ValueError: cannot convert float NaN to integer
explanation: NaN has no integer representation.
likely_cause: A missing or invalid numeric result reaches int().
fix: Check math.isnan or math.isfinite and define how missing values should be handled before conversion.

title: Relative import outside package
example_error: ImportError: attempted relative import with no known parent package
explanation: A relative import lacks package context.
likely_cause: A package module was executed as a standalone script.
fix: Run it from the package parent with python -m package.module and keep the package structure intact.

title: Local file shadows package
example_error: AttributeError: partially initialized module 'requests' has no attribute 'get'
explanation: Python imported a same-named local module instead of the intended library.
likely_cause: The project contains requests.py or a requests directory that shadows the dependency.
fix: Rename the local module, remove its stale cached bytecode if needed, and restart the interpreter.

title: Invalid list index type
example_error: TypeError: list indices must be integers or slices, not str
explanation: A list received a text key.
likely_cause: The data is a list of records but code treats it as one dictionary.
fix: Inspect the parsed structure, select the appropriate list item, then access its dictionary key.

title: Set changed during iteration
example_error: RuntimeError: Set changed size during iteration
explanation: A set iterator was invalidated by adding or removing members.
likely_cause: The loop modifies the same set it traverses.
fix: Iterate over a copy or compute the desired set with a comprehension and assign it afterward.

title: Missing nonlocal binding
example_error: SyntaxError: no binding for nonlocal 'count' found
explanation: nonlocal refers to a name absent from enclosing function scopes.
likely_cause: The variable exists only globally or has not been defined in the outer function.
fix: Define it in the enclosing function or redesign the function to accept and return the state.

title: Non-default parameter after default
example_error: SyntaxError: non-default argument follows default argument
explanation: A required positional parameter follows an optional positional parameter.
likely_cause: The function signature puts defaulted parameters first.
fix: Place required positional parameters before optional ones or make later required parameters keyword-only.

title: F-string brace mismatch
example_error: SyntaxError: f-string: expecting '}'
explanation: An f-string expression has an unclosed brace.
likely_cause: A literal brace was not escaped or the embedded expression is incomplete.
fix: Close expression braces and double literal braces as {{ and }} inside f-strings.

title: Positional row out of bounds
example_error: IndexError: single positional indexer is out-of-bounds
explanation: iloc requested a row or column position that does not exist.
likely_cause: Filtering left fewer rows than expected.
fix: Check df.shape and handle empty frames before selecting with iloc.

title: Labels not in index
example_error: KeyError: None of [Index(['a', 'b'])] are in the [columns]
explanation: A list of requested labels has no matches.
likely_cause: The wrong axis or header row was selected.
fix: Inspect index and columns, then select the correct axis or fix read_csv header settings.

title: Duplicate labels prevent reindexing
example_error: ValueError: cannot reindex on an axis with duplicate labels
explanation: The alignment operation requires unique labels.
likely_cause: Concatenation or ingestion created duplicate index values.
fix: Check index.is_unique and decide whether to aggregate duplicates or reset the index before alignment.

title: Duplicate index prevents pivot
example_error: ValueError: Index contains duplicate entries, cannot reshape
explanation: pivot expects a unique value for each row-column pair.
likely_cause: Multiple records share the same pivot keys.
fix: Inspect duplicates; use pivot_table with an explicit aggregation only when combining records is appropriate.

title: Concatenation has no objects
example_error: ValueError: No objects to concatenate
explanation: pd.concat received an empty collection.
likely_cause: A file glob found nothing or filtering removed every frame.
fix: Check the collected frames and return an explicitly shaped empty frame or report missing input.

title: Scalar DataFrame needs index
example_error: ValueError: If using all scalar values, you must pass an index
explanation: A dictionary of scalar values does not define a row count.
likely_cause: A single record was passed directly to DataFrame.
fix: Wrap the record in a list, as pd.DataFrame([record]), or provide an intentional index.

title: Different array lengths
example_error: ValueError: All arrays must be of the same length
explanation: DataFrame columns supplied as arrays have different lengths.
likely_cause: Data was collected unevenly across fields.
fix: Validate record completeness or build rows as dictionaries; align by explicit indexes when missing rows are intentional.

title: Cannot insert existing column
example_error: ValueError: cannot insert id, already exists
explanation: The insertion would create a conflicting column label.
likely_cause: reset_index tries to add an index whose name matches an existing column.
fix: Rename the index, or use reset_index(drop=True) if the old index should be discarded.

title: Datetime accessor on text
example_error: AttributeError: Can only use .dt accessor with datetimelike values
explanation: The Series does not have a datetime-like dtype.
likely_cause: Date strings were never parsed.
fix: Use pd.to_datetime with an explicit format and inspect invalid values before calling .dt.

title: Timezone aware and naive comparison
example_error: TypeError: Invalid comparison between dtype=datetime64[ns, UTC] and Timestamp
explanation: The operands disagree about timezone awareness.
likely_cause: An aware Series is compared with a naive timestamp.
fix: Localize the naive value to its intended timezone, then convert both sides to a common timezone.

title: Localizing an aware timestamp
example_error: TypeError: Already tz-aware, use tz_convert to convert
explanation: tz_localize is being used on already-aware data.
likely_cause: Timezone assignment is confused with timezone conversion.
fix: Use tz_convert to change the represented timezone; use tz_localize only to assign meaning to naive clock times.

title: Converting a naive timestamp timezone
example_error: TypeError: Cannot convert tz-naive timestamps, use tz_localize to localize
explanation: Timezone conversion needs an existing timezone.
likely_cause: Naive timestamps have not been assigned their source timezone.
fix: Apply tz_localize with the true source zone before tz_convert to the target zone.

title: Ambiguous daylight-saving time
example_error: AmbiguousTimeError: Cannot infer dst time from 2025-11-02 01:30:00
explanation: The local clock time occurred twice during a daylight-saving transition.
likely_cause: Naive timestamps fall in the repeated hour.
fix: Provide an explicit ambiguous policy based on source information or keep unambiguous UTC timestamps.

title: Nonexistent daylight-saving time
example_error: NonExistentTimeError: 2025-03-09 02:30:00
explanation: The local clock time was skipped during a daylight-saving transition.
likely_cause: Localization encounters the missing spring-forward hour.
fix: Choose a documented nonexistent policy such as shifting forward only if it matches the data's intended meaning.

title: Datetime outside supported range
example_error: OutOfBoundsDatetime: Out of bounds nanosecond timestamp
explanation: A timestamp cannot fit the requested datetime resolution.
likely_cause: The value is erroneous or outside nanosecond limits.
fix: Validate dates and choose a coarser supported resolution when the historical or future date is legitimate.

title: Unalignable boolean mask
example_error: pandas.errors.IndexingError: Unalignable boolean Series provided as indexer
explanation: The boolean mask's labels do not align with the target axis.
likely_cause: The mask came from another frame or indexes changed.
fix: Build the mask from the target frame or explicitly reindex it with a deliberate missing-value policy.

title: Boolean mask contains missing values
example_error: ValueError: Cannot mask with non-boolean array containing NA / NaN values
explanation: The selection mask includes missing values instead of booleans.
likely_cause: String matching on nullable data produced missing mask entries.
fix: Use str.contains(pattern, na=False) when missing means no match, or fill the mask according to the intended rule.

title: New value absent from categories
example_error: TypeError: Cannot setitem on a Categorical with a new category
explanation: Categorical data accepts only declared categories.
likely_cause: An assignment introduces a new label.
fix: Add the category with .cat.add_categories before assignment or deliberately convert to a more flexible dtype.

title: Cannot compare unordered categories
example_error: TypeError: Unordered Categoricals can only compare equality or not
explanation: Ordering is undefined for this categorical dtype.
likely_cause: Code uses greater-than or sorting semantics requiring a declared order.
fix: Define an ordered CategoricalDtype with the intended category sequence before ordinal comparisons.

title: Merge columns overlap
example_error: ValueError: columns overlap but no suffix specified
explanation: A join would create ambiguous duplicate column names.
likely_cause: Both frames contain non-key columns with the same name.
fix: Rename columns or supply explicit suffixes so the output preserves their source meaning.

title: Merge key missing
example_error: KeyError: 'join_id' while merging DataFrames
explanation: The named merge key is absent from one input.
likely_cause: Left and right tables use different key names.
fix: Inspect both schemas and pass left_on and right_on for differently named keys.

title: Merge is not one-to-one
example_error: pandas.errors.MergeError: Merge keys are not unique in left dataset; not a one-to-one merge
explanation: The declared relationship conflicts with duplicate join keys.
likely_cause: The left table contains repeated identifiers.
fix: Inspect duplicate keys and correct data or select the appropriate validate relationship only when repetition is expected.

title: Merge-asof keys unsorted
example_error: ValueError: left keys must be sorted
explanation: merge_asof requires sorted temporal or numeric join keys.
likely_cause: The left input is not sorted by the as-of key.
fix: Sort both frames by the merge key as required and verify its dtype before merging.

title: Groupby selection is not one dimensional
example_error: ValueError: Grouper for 'team' not 1-dimensional
explanation: The grouping label resolves to multiple columns or levels.
likely_cause: Duplicate column names or an unexpected MultiIndex creates ambiguity.
fix: Inspect df.columns and make the grouping label identify exactly one Series.

title: Aggregation has no numeric data
example_error: TypeError: agg function failed [how->mean,dtype->object]
explanation: The selected aggregation cannot operate on the column values.
likely_cause: Numeric-looking strings or mixed text are included in a mean.
fix: Select numeric columns and parse intended numeric data with pd.to_numeric, checking conversion failures.

title: Removed iteritems method
example_error: AttributeError: 'Series' object has no attribute 'iteritems'
explanation: The installed pandas version removed the old iteration alias.
likely_cause: Older code calls iteritems.
fix: Use Series.items() and test the migrated code against the pinned pandas version.

title: Removed as_matrix method
example_error: AttributeError: 'DataFrame' object has no attribute 'as_matrix'
explanation: The obsolete array conversion method is unavailable.
likely_cause: Legacy code targets an older pandas API.
fix: Use df.to_numpy() and explicitly select columns and dtype when downstream code depends on them.

title: Invalid fillna method
example_error: ValueError: Invalid fill method. Expecting pad (ffill) or backfill (bfill)
explanation: The requested fill operation is not a supported directional method.
likely_cause: A misspelled method or an interpolation method was passed to a fill API.
fix: Use .ffill() or .bfill() for directional filling; use .interpolate() for numerical interpolation.

title: Empty CSV
example_error: pandas.errors.EmptyDataError: No columns to parse from file
explanation: The parser found no usable column data.
likely_cause: The file is empty, whitespace-only, or all rows were skipped.
fix: Check file size and parser options and handle genuinely empty input before constructing the expected schema.

title: Missing Excel reader
example_error: ImportError: Missing optional dependency 'openpyxl'
explanation: Reading the workbook requires an optional engine.
likely_cause: openpyxl is absent from the active environment.
fix: Install a compatible openpyxl version in the same environment and record it in dependencies.

title: Excel format cannot be determined
example_error: ValueError: Excel file format cannot be determined, you must specify an engine manually
explanation: pandas cannot infer the workbook format.
likely_cause: The extension is wrong, the file is temporary, or the content is not an Excel workbook.
fix: Verify the actual file format and select its supported engine; use read_csv for CSV content.

title: Missing Parquet engine
example_error: ImportError: Unable to find a usable engine; tried using: 'pyarrow', 'fastparquet'
explanation: Parquet support needs an optional engine.
likely_cause: Neither supported engine is installed.
fix: Install and pin a compatible pyarrow or fastparquet release in the environment running pandas.

title: Invalid numeric text
example_error: ValueError: Unable to parse string "unknown" at position 2
explanation: pd.to_numeric encountered nonnumeric content.
likely_cause: A numeric field contains sentinel text or malformed input.
fix: Inspect the invalid records and replace known sentinels deliberately; use errors='coerce' only with checks for introduced missing values.

title: Wrong number of renamed columns
example_error: ValueError: Length mismatch: Expected axis has 3 elements, new values have 2 elements
explanation: The replacement labels do not match the axis length.
likely_cause: The assumed number of columns differs from the loaded frame.
fix: Inspect df.shape and use rename for selected labels or supply exactly one new label per column.

title: Multiple columns assigned to one
example_error: ValueError: Cannot set a DataFrame with multiple columns to the single column result
explanation: The right-hand side has more than one column.
likely_cause: An apply operation or selection returns a frame instead of a Series.
fix: Assign to matching destination columns or reduce the right-hand side to the intended single Series.

title: Apply result has incompatible index
example_error: TypeError: incompatible index of inserted column with frame index
explanation: The computed result cannot align to the destination rows.
likely_cause: groupby.apply returns a hierarchical or differently shaped index.
fix: Use groupby.transform for one result per original row, or merge an explicitly keyed aggregate.

title: Invalid resampling index
example_error: TypeError: Only valid with DatetimeIndex, TimedeltaIndex or PeriodIndex, but got an instance of 'RangeIndex'
explanation: Resampling requires a time-based axis.
likely_cause: The date column has not been parsed or selected as the resampling key.
fix: Parse the date column and use resample with on='date' or set a suitable datetime index.

title: Invalid rolling window
example_error: ValueError: window must be an integer 0 or greater
explanation: The rolling window argument is invalid for the current index.
likely_cause: A negative count or time offset is used with a non-time index.
fix: Use a positive integer row window or a supported time offset with a datetime-like index.

title: Duplicate column JSON export
example_error: ValueError: DataFrame columns must be unique for orient='records'
explanation: This JSON orientation needs unambiguous field names.
likely_cause: The frame contains duplicate column labels.
fix: Rename or consolidate duplicate columns before exporting records.

title: Read-only array assignment
example_error: ValueError: assignment destination is read-only while modifying to_numpy output
explanation: The exported NumPy view does not allow mutation.
likely_cause: Copy-on-write or shared underlying storage protects the frame's data.
fix: Request to_numpy(copy=True) for independent array mutation, or update the DataFrame through .loc.

title: Requirements file missing
example_error: ERROR: Could not open requirements file: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'requirements.txt'
explanation: pip cannot read the dependency list at that path.
likely_cause: The command runs from the wrong directory or the file has another name.
fix: Pass the correct path to python -m pip install -r and verify the file exists.

title: Invalid requirement syntax
example_error: ERROR: Invalid requirement: 'requests=== '
explanation: The dependency specification cannot be parsed.
likely_cause: The requirements line has malformed version syntax or pasted shell text.
fix: Use a valid project requirement such as requests==2.32.5 and keep shell commands out of requirements files.

title: Hash mismatch
example_error: ERROR: THESE PACKAGES DO NOT MATCH THE HASHES FROM THE REQUIREMENTS FILE
explanation: The downloaded file's hash differs from the locked expected hash.
likely_cause: The artifact changed, the lock targets another wheel, or the download is damaged.
fix: Verify the trusted source and regenerate hashes only for intentionally reviewed artifacts; do not simply disable verification.

title: Proxy connection failure
example_error: ProxyError: Cannot connect to proxy
explanation: pip cannot connect through its configured proxy.
likely_cause: The proxy address, authentication, or network route is incorrect.
fix: Check the approved proxy settings and credentials without printing them, then retry through the correct network.

title: Package index unauthorized
example_error: ERROR: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: package index
explanation: The index rejects the provided authentication.
likely_cause: A private registry token is missing or expired.
fix: Authenticate using the registry's supported credential mechanism and avoid embedding tokens in committed requirements or logs.

title: Package index forbidden
example_error: ERROR: 403 Client Error: Forbidden for url: package index
explanation: The server denies access to the requested package.
likely_cause: The identity lacks repository permissions or policy blocks the package.
fix: Confirm repository access with the registry administrator and use an authorized source.

title: Python version excluded
example_error: ERROR: Package requires a different Python: 3.14 not in '<3.13'
explanation: The package declares the current interpreter unsupported.
likely_cause: The environment uses a newer or older Python than the release supports.
fix: Create an environment with a supported interpreter or choose a package release supporting the current version.

title: Wheel platform incompatible
example_error: ERROR: package.whl is not a supported wheel on this platform
explanation: The wheel tags do not match this interpreter and platform.
likely_cause: A wheel was downloaded for a different Python ABI, CPU architecture, or operating system.
fix: Use pip's normal index resolution or download a wheel matching python -m pip debug --verbose compatibility tags.

title: Invalid wheel filename
example_error: ERROR: Invalid wheel filename (wrong number of parts)
explanation: The wheel name does not follow the required filename structure.
likely_cause: The downloaded file was renamed or is not a wheel.
fix: Download the original wheel filename from the trusted project source rather than renaming an unrelated archive.

title: Build backend unavailable
example_error: BackendUnavailable: Cannot import 'setuptools.build_meta'
explanation: The configured build backend cannot be imported.
likely_cause: Build requirements are missing or build isolation was disabled prematurely.
fix: Check pyproject.toml build-system requirements and use normal isolated builds with the declared backend installed.

title: Build dependencies cannot install
example_error: ERROR: pip subprocess to install build dependencies did not run successfully
explanation: The isolated build environment could not install its prerequisites.
likely_cause: The index is unreachable or a build requirement has no compatible release.
fix: Read the nested pip error and resolve the network or version constraint for the build dependency.

title: Metadata generation failed
example_error: error: metadata-generation-failed
explanation: The package failed while preparing installation metadata.
likely_cause: Its setup code or backend encountered an error before wheel building.
fix: Read the first backend traceback and check the package's supported Python and build dependencies.

title: C compiler missing
example_error: error: Microsoft Visual C++ 14.0 or greater is required
explanation: A source distribution needs a Windows C/C++ compiler.
likely_cause: No matching wheel exists and the compiler toolchain is absent.
fix: Prefer a compatible published wheel or install the documented Microsoft C++ build tools for the package.

title: Python headers missing
example_error: fatal error: Python.h: No such file or directory
explanation: Native extension compilation cannot locate Python development headers.
likely_cause: The development package for the interpreter is missing.
fix: Install matching Python development headers using the platform's package manager, or use an available compatible wheel.

title: Rust compiler missing
example_error: error: can't find Rust compiler
explanation: The source package includes a Rust extension.
likely_cause: A wheel is unavailable and the Rust toolchain is not installed.
fix: Use a supported interpreter with a wheel or install the package's documented Rust toolchain before building.

title: pkg-config dependency missing
example_error: error: command 'pkg-config' failed: No such file or directory
explanation: A native dependency discovery tool is unavailable.
likely_cause: A source build expects pkg-config and system library development files.
fix: Install the documented system prerequisites or use a supported prebuilt package distribution.

title: Git executable missing
example_error: ERROR: Cannot find command 'git' - do you have 'git' installed and in your PATH?
explanation: A VCS requirement requires Git.
likely_cause: Git is absent or not visible to the current shell.
fix: Install Git and reopen the shell, or install a published release from an approved package index.

title: VCS revision not found
example_error: ERROR: git checkout revision did not run successfully
explanation: The requested repository revision cannot be checked out.
likely_cause: A branch, tag, or commit is misspelled or unavailable.
fix: Verify the repository and pin an existing commit or release tag with appropriate access.

title: Local project lacks build configuration
example_error: ERROR: Directory '.' is not installable. Neither 'setup.py' nor 'pyproject.toml' found
explanation: The selected folder is not recognized as a Python package project.
likely_cause: pip install . ran from the wrong directory or packaging metadata is missing.
fix: Change to the package root or add a valid pyproject.toml for the project being packaged.

title: Editable build unsupported
example_error: ERROR: Project has a pyproject.toml and its build backend is missing the build_editable hook
explanation: The backend cannot produce the requested editable install.
likely_cause: The backend version does not support editable builds.
fix: Upgrade to a compatible backend supporting editable installs or use a regular install for this project.

title: Uninstall missing RECORD
example_error: ERROR: Cannot uninstall package, RECORD file not found
explanation: pip lacks the installed-file manifest needed for a normal uninstall.
likely_cause: The package came from another manager or installation metadata is damaged.
fix: Use the original package manager or recreate the virtual environment from pinned requirements instead of deleting arbitrary files.

title: Distutils package cannot uninstall
example_error: ERROR: Cannot uninstall package. It is a distutils installed project
explanation: pip cannot determine which files belong to the legacy installation.
likely_cause: An older system or distutils installation has incomplete metadata.
fix: Use a fresh virtual environment and avoid modifying the system-managed package in place.

title: Installed dependencies inconsistent
example_error: ERROR: pip's dependency resolver does not currently take into account all the packages that are installed
explanation: The installation left conflicts with packages already present.
likely_cause: A new requirement changed shared dependencies in an existing environment.
fix: Run python -m pip check, reconcile constraints, and install the full compatible requirement set in a clean environment.

title: pip check missing dependency
example_error: package requires dependency, which is not installed
explanation: An installed distribution lacks a declared dependency.
likely_cause: Installation used --no-deps or was interrupted.
fix: Install the required compatible dependency through the pinned requirement set, then rerun python -m pip check.

title: Insufficient install permissions
example_error: ERROR: Could not install packages due to an OSError: [Errno 13] Permission denied
explanation: pip cannot write to the target installation directory.
likely_cause: The command targets a protected system environment.
fix: Create and activate a user-owned virtual environment and install with that interpreter's python -m pip.

title: Install path too long on Windows
example_error: OSError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory ... HINT: This error might have occurred since this system does not have Windows Long Path support enabled
explanation: A generated installation path exceeds supported path limits.
likely_cause: A deeply nested environment combines with long package filenames.
fix: Use a shorter environment path or enable supported long-path configuration through the system's documented settings.

title: Invalid distribution warning
example_error: WARNING: Ignoring invalid distribution ~ip
explanation: pip found malformed distribution metadata.
likely_cause: An interrupted update left an incomplete package directory.
fix: Inspect the environment and recreate it from requirements if possible; avoid deleting unrelated site-packages content.

title: Legacy setup.py command failed
example_error: error: subprocess-exited-with-error python setup.py egg_info did not run successfully
explanation: Legacy package setup failed in a subprocess.
likely_cause: Its setup script depends on unavailable tools or incompatible Python behavior.
fix: Read the first setup traceback and use a maintained compatible release or its documented build prerequisites.

title: Route not found
example_error: 404 Not Found when requesting /items
explanation: No route matches the requested path.
likely_cause: The router prefix, application mount, or requested URL differs from the registered route.
fix: Inspect /openapi.json and include_router prefixes, then request the exact path.

title: HTTP method not allowed
example_error: 405 Method Not Allowed on POST /items
explanation: The path exists but does not accept that HTTP method.
likely_cause: The client sends POST to a GET-only handler.
fix: Use the method declared by the endpoint or add the intended method handler explicitly.

title: Trailing slash redirect
example_error: 307 Temporary Redirect from /items to /items/
explanation: The router redirects to its registered trailing-slash form.
likely_cause: The client URL differs only by the final slash.
fix: Call the canonical route URL and ensure the client preserves method and body when following redirects.

title: Malformed JSON body
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: JSON decode error loc body
explanation: The request body is not syntactically valid JSON.
likely_cause: A client sends a trailing comma, invalid quote, or truncated body.
fix: Serialize the payload with a JSON library and send it with Content-Type application/json.

title: Body must be an object
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Input should be a valid dictionary or object to extract fields from
explanation: The request model expects an object.
likely_cause: The client sent an array, scalar, or JSON-encoded string.
fix: Send a JSON object matching the request model instead of double-encoding the body.

title: Forbidden extra request fields
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Extra inputs are not permitted
explanation: The request includes keys forbidden by the model configuration.
likely_cause: A typo or outdated client sends an unsupported field.
fix: Remove the extra key and follow the endpoint schema; keep extra='forbid' when strict contracts are intended.

title: Text exceeds maximum length
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: String should have at most 5000 characters
explanation: A request field exceeds its declared length bound.
likely_cause: The client pasted more text than the endpoint accepts.
fix: Send the relevant error and nearby traceback within the limit and mirror the bound in the client UI.

title: Text below minimum length
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: String should have at least 1 character
explanation: A required string is too short.
likely_cause: The client submitted an empty input.
fix: Validate the field before sending and include meaningful text rather than padding it with whitespace.

title: Number exceeds allowed maximum
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Input should be less than or equal to 5
explanation: A numeric field exceeds its upper bound.
likely_cause: The caller requests more items than supported.
fix: Send a value within the documented range and constrain the client control to that range.

title: Number below allowed minimum
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Input should be greater than or equal to 1
explanation: A numeric field is below its lower bound.
likely_cause: The caller sends zero or a negative count.
fix: Use a positive value inside the endpoint's documented range.

title: Strict integer rejects string
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Input should be a valid integer type
explanation: Strict validation requires a JSON integer rather than coercible text.
likely_cause: A form or client serialized the number as a quoted string.
fix: Convert the value to an integer in the client and send it as a JSON number.

title: Invalid enum choice
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Input should be 'small', 'medium' or 'large'
explanation: The value is outside the enumerated choices.
likely_cause: The client uses a misspelled or unsupported option.
fix: Use one of the schema's allowed enum values and keep frontend options synchronized with the contract.

title: Invalid UUID
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Input should be a valid UUID
explanation: The identifier is not a valid UUID representation.
likely_cause: A numeric ID or malformed string was sent to a UUID field.
fix: Send a valid UUID, or change the model only if the API intentionally uses another identifier type.

title: Invalid datetime request
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Input should be a valid datetime or date
explanation: The submitted timestamp cannot be parsed.
likely_cause: The client uses a locale-specific date format or invalid date.
fix: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp and include timezone information when required by the application.

title: Missing query parameter
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Field required loc query q
explanation: The endpoint requires a query parameter.
likely_cause: The value was omitted or sent in the body instead.
fix: Include ?q=value in the URL using a URL encoder, or change the endpoint declaration if body input is intended.

title: Missing required header
example_error: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Field required loc header x-api-key
explanation: A declared required header is absent.
likely_cause: The client omitted the header or used the wrong header name.
fix: Send the documented header; configure CORS to permit it for browser clients without exposing server secrets.

title: Invalid bearer credentials
example_error: 401 Unauthorized: Not authenticated
explanation: The authentication dependency cannot establish an identity.
likely_cause: A bearer token is absent, expired, or invalid.
fix: Obtain a valid token through the configured login flow and send Authorization: Bearer with the token value.

title: Permission dependency denied
example_error: 403 Forbidden: Not enough permissions
explanation: The authenticated identity lacks permission for the action.
likely_cause: A required scope or role is missing.
fix: Verify the required scope and grant only the appropriate access or use an authorized identity.

title: Duplicate operation ID warning
example_error: UserWarning: Duplicate Operation ID for function
explanation: Generated OpenAPI operations share an identifier.
likely_cause: A router is registered twice or custom IDs are reused.
fix: Remove duplicate registration and give each operation a stable unique operation_id when customizing it.

title: Invalid response field type
example_error: fastapi.exceptions.FastAPIError: Invalid args for response field!
explanation: A declared response annotation cannot become a Pydantic response field.
likely_cause: A raw database session or unsupported class is used as a return type.
fix: Return a supported response model or Response object; use response_model=None only when validation is intentionally handled elsewhere.

title: Dependency receives Depends object
example_error: AttributeError: 'Depends' object has no attribute 'query'
explanation: The dependency marker was not resolved into a real object.
likely_cause: A function using Depends was called directly outside FastAPI injection.
fix: Pass the actual dependency in ordinary Python calls or let FastAPI invoke the function as a declared dependency.

title: Yield dependency never yields
example_error: RuntimeError: generator didn't yield
explanation: The dependency context manager completed before providing a value.
likely_cause: A conditional path returns before the yield.
fix: Ensure successful paths yield exactly once and raise an appropriate exception on setup failure.

title: Yield dependency yields twice
example_error: RuntimeError: generator didn't stop
explanation: A context-managed dependency produced another value during cleanup.
likely_cause: The dependency contains multiple yields or loops around yield.
fix: Yield exactly one resource, then perform cleanup in a finally block.

title: Application startup failed
example_error: ERROR: Application startup failed. Exiting.
explanation: The ASGI lifespan startup raised an exception.
likely_cause: A required resource could not initialize or configuration is missing.
fix: Read the preceding startup traceback and validate configuration and resource availability before accepting requests.

title: ASGI app attribute missing
example_error: ERROR: Error loading ASGI app. Attribute "app" not found in module "main"
explanation: The module imports but does not expose the requested application name.
likely_cause: The FastAPI instance uses another variable name or is only created under a main guard.
fix: Export the app instance at module scope and use the matching module:attribute target.

title: App factory treated as application
example_error: TypeError: create_app() takes 0 positional arguments but 3 were given
explanation: The server passed ASGI arguments to a factory function.
likely_cause: The launch target is a factory but factory mode is absent.
fix: Use uvicorn module:create_app --factory or export the created app instance.

title: Response content-length mismatch
example_error: RuntimeError: Response content shorter than Content-Length
explanation: The body size disagrees with the declared header.
likely_cause: Code manually sets an incorrect Content-Length or mutates a response afterward.
fix: Let the response class calculate Content-Length and avoid modifying the body after headers are prepared.

title: NaN in JSON response
example_error: ValueError: Out of range float values are not JSON compliant
explanation: The response contains NaN or infinity, which standard JSON cannot represent.
likely_cause: Calculations or DataFrame output contain nonfinite numbers.
fix: Convert nonfinite values to null or a documented error representation before serialization.

title: Streaming generator fails
example_error: RuntimeError: Caught handled exception, but response already started
explanation: An error occurs after response headers have been sent.
likely_cause: A streaming generator raises HTTPException partway through the stream.
fix: Validate prerequisites before streaming and define an in-stream error protocol for failures after headers are sent.

title: Background task exception
example_error: ERROR: Exception in ASGI application during BackgroundTasks
explanation: A task raised after the response was sent.
likely_cause: The background function fails on external work or cleanup.
fix: Catch and record operational failures without logging request secrets, and use a durable job system when retries or guarantees are needed.

title: WebSocket disconnect
example_error: starlette.websockets.WebSocketDisconnect: 1000
explanation: The peer closed the WebSocket normally.
likely_cause: A client tab closed or intentionally ended the session.
fix: Catch WebSocketDisconnect, release per-connection resources, and avoid continuing to receive on the closed socket.

title: WebSocket send after close
example_error: RuntimeError: Cannot call "send" once a close message has been sent
explanation: Code writes to a closed WebSocket.
likely_cause: A concurrent task continues after connection shutdown.
fix: Coordinate cancellation of sender tasks and stop writes once the connection is closed.

title: WebSocket not accepted
example_error: RuntimeError: WebSocket is not connected. Need to call "accept" first.
explanation: The handler tries to receive data before completing the handshake.
likely_cause: websocket.accept() was omitted.
fix: Authenticate as designed, await websocket.accept(), then start receiving messages.

title: Credentialed CORS wildcard
example_error: Credential is not supported if the CORS header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' is '*'
explanation: The browser rejects credentialed access with a wildcard origin.
likely_cause: Cookie-based requests are combined with permissive wildcard CORS.
fix: Configure explicit trusted origins and allow_credentials=True only when credentialed browser requests are required.

title: CORS preflight method denied
example_error: 400 Bad Request: Disallowed CORS method
explanation: The preflight requests a method absent from the allowed list.
likely_cause: The frontend uses POST but middleware only allows GET.
fix: Add the endpoint's actual method to allow_methods and retest the OPTIONS request with the frontend Origin.

title: CORS preflight header denied
example_error: 400 Bad Request: Disallowed CORS headers
explanation: A requested browser header is not permitted.
likely_cause: The client adds a custom header not listed in middleware.
fix: Allow the specific needed header and remove unnecessary custom headers from the client.

title: Request body stream consumed
example_error: RuntimeError: Stream consumed
explanation: The request stream was already read and cannot be consumed again that way.
likely_cause: Middleware or a handler consumes stream() before another body reader.
fix: Read and pass parsed data once, or design middleware to preserve the body correctly for downstream consumers.

title: Service artifact unavailable
example_error: 503 Service Unavailable: Search artifact unavailable
explanation: The API is running but its required saved search artifact is not ready.
likely_cause: The file is missing, corrupt, or built with an incompatible scikit-learn version.
fix: Build or restore the trusted pipeline.joblib, install its exact dependency versions, and restart the service to load it.

title: Removing an absent list item
example_error: items.remove('archived'): ValueError: list.remove(x): x not in list
explanation: Removal requires an equal element.
likely_cause: The target is absent.
fix: Test membership or catch ValueError when absence is expected.

title: Popping an empty list
example_error: stack.pop(): IndexError: pop from empty list
explanation: There is no element to remove.
likely_cause: The stack was exhausted.
fix: Check stack before popping or handle IndexError.

title: Finding an absent list element
example_error: items.index('closed'): ValueError: 'closed' is not in list
explanation: index cannot return a position for an absent value.
likely_cause: No element equals the search value.
fix: Check membership or handle ValueError with an explicit not-found result.

title: Noninteger slice boundary
example_error: items[:2.5]: TypeError: slice indices must be integers or None or have an __index__ method
explanation: Slice boundaries must represent integer positions.
likely_cause: A float calculation produced the boundary.
fix: Validate the position and convert using an intentional rounding rule.

title: Zero slice step
example_error: items[::0]: ValueError: slice step cannot be zero
explanation: A slice must advance through its input.
likely_cause: A computed step became zero.
fix: Reject zero and select a positive or negative nonzero step.

title: Extended slice assignment size
example_error: items[::2] = [1]: ValueError: attempt to assign sequence of size 1 to extended slice of size 3
explanation: A stepped slice needs matching replacement length.
likely_cause: Too few replacement elements were supplied.
fix: Provide one value per selected position or use a normal contiguous slice.

title: Empty sequence maximum
example_error: max([]): ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence
explanation: No maximum exists without elements.
likely_cause: Filtering removed every candidate.
fix: Use max(values, default=sentinel) and handle the sentinel explicitly.

title: Empty sequence minimum
example_error: min([]): ValueError: min() arg is an empty sequence
explanation: No minimum exists without elements.
likely_cause: The candidate collection is empty.
fix: Provide a default or report that no candidates remain.

title: Strict zip length mismatch
example_error: zip(left, right, strict=True): ValueError: zip() argument 2 is longer than argument 1
explanation: Strict pairing detected unequal lengths.
likely_cause: The two sources have different record counts.
fix: Reconcile source lengths instead of silently truncating paired records.

title: Repeating a sequence by float
example_error: names * 2.5: TypeError: can't multiply sequence by non-int of type 'float'
explanation: Sequence repetition needs an integer count.
likely_cause: A decimal quantity was used as a repetition count.
fix: Use an integer count or numeric arrays for elementwise multiplication.

title: Popping an absent dictionary key
example_error: settings.pop('region'): KeyError: 'region'
explanation: The required key cannot be removed.
likely_cause: The settings record lacks region.
fix: Supply a pop default when optional or validate required keys first.

title: Popping an empty dictionary
example_error: cache.popitem(): KeyError: 'popitem(): dictionary is empty'
explanation: No dictionary pair remains.
likely_cause: The cache was drained.
fix: Check the dictionary or handle KeyError during draining.

title: Malformed dictionary pair input
example_error: dict([('a', 1, 2)]): ValueError: dictionary update sequence element #0 has length 3; 2 is required
explanation: Each supplied item must have two components.
likely_cause: A record contains three fields.
fix: Build explicit key-value pairs before passing them to dict.

title: Nonmapping dictionary expansion
example_error: {**[1, 2]}: TypeError: 'list' object is not a mapping
explanation: Double-star expansion needs a mapping.
likely_cause: A list was passed where named keys were expected.
fix: Convert valid pairs to a dictionary or use list unpacking instead.

title: Nonstring keyword keys
example_error: handler(**{1: 'value'}): TypeError: keywords must be strings
explanation: Keyword arguments use textual parameter names.
likely_cause: A dictionary contains numeric keys.
fix: Map external keys to declared string parameter names before calling.

title: Absent set member removal
example_error: members.remove('guest'): KeyError: 'guest'
explanation: Strict set removal requires membership.
likely_cause: The member was already removed.
fix: Use discard when removal should tolerate absence.

title: Popping an empty set
example_error: pending.pop(): KeyError: 'pop from an empty set'
explanation: The set has no member to return.
likely_cause: All pending members were processed.
fix: Guard emptiness or handle KeyError as completion.

title: Set union with a list operator
example_error: {1, 2} + [3]: TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'set' and 'list'
explanation: Addition is not a set union operation.
likely_cause: List and set APIs were mixed.
fix: Use the set union method with the iterable.

title: Dictionary view indexing
example_error: mapping.keys()[0]: TypeError: 'dict_keys' object is not subscriptable
explanation: Dictionary views do not support positional indexing.
likely_cause: A view was treated as a list.
fix: Use next(iter(mapping), default) or materialize a list when positions matter.

title: Dictionary view mutation
example_error: mapping.values().append(3): AttributeError: 'dict_values' object has no attribute 'append'
explanation: A view reflects a dictionary and cannot append independently.
likely_cause: Code expects a mutable list of values.
fix: Assign a dictionary key or copy values into a list for separate editing.

title: Substring not found
example_error: message.index('END'): ValueError: substring not found
explanation: The requested delimiter is absent.
likely_cause: The input lacks the expected marker.
fix: Use find and check -1, or validate the delimiter before slicing.

title: Empty string separator
example_error: message.split(''): ValueError: empty separator
explanation: split requires a nonempty explicit separator.
likely_cause: An empty configuration value reached split.
fix: Use list(message) for characters or provide a real delimiter.

title: Invalid partition separator
example_error: message.partition(''): ValueError: empty separator
explanation: Partitioning cannot divide around an empty delimiter.
likely_cause: A delimiter setting is blank.
fix: Validate the configured separator before partitioning.

title: Replacement argument is numeric
example_error: message.replace('old', 5): TypeError: replace() argument 2 must be str, not int
explanation: Replacement text must be a string.
likely_cause: A numeric replacement was passed directly.
fix: Convert the value to its intended text representation.

title: Startswith argument is a list
example_error: name.startswith(['a', 'b']): TypeError: startswith first arg must be str or a tuple of str, not list
explanation: Prefix alternatives use a tuple.
likely_cause: A list of prefixes was supplied.
fix: Pass tuple(prefixes) after validating that each prefix is text.

title: Character ordinal input too long
example_error: ord('ab'): TypeError: ord() expected a character, but string of length 2 found
explanation: ord converts one character.
likely_cause: The input contains multiple characters.
fix: Validate length one or apply ord separately to each character.

title: Character code outside Unicode
example_error: chr(1114112): ValueError: chr() arg not in range(0x110000)
explanation: The integer is outside Unicode's code-point range.
likely_cause: An invalid character code was decoded.
fix: Validate the code-point range before calling chr.

title: Missing format placeholder key
example_error: '{city}'.format(country='US'): KeyError: 'city'
explanation: The template needs a missing named value.
likely_cause: The format mapping omits city.
fix: Supply the named field or validate templates against available keys.

title: Missing positional format value
example_error: '{} {}'.format('one'): IndexError: Replacement index 1 out of range for positional args tuple
explanation: The template requests more arguments than supplied.
likely_cause: A placeholder was added without a corresponding value.
