fix: Provide every argument or remove the unintended placeholder.

title: Numeric format applied to text
example_error: format('12', '.2f'): ValueError: Unknown format code 'f' for object of type 'str'
explanation: Fixed-point formatting expects a number.
likely_cause: A numeric-looking string was not parsed.
fix: Validate and parse the numeric value before formatting it.

title: Byte value out of range
example_error: bytes([256]): ValueError: bytes must be in range(0, 256)
explanation: A byte stores only values from zero through 255.
likely_cause: An integer exceeds one byte.
fix: Validate the range or encode the integer using multiple bytes.

title: Negative byte allocation
example_error: bytearray(-1): ValueError: negative count
explanation: Buffer size cannot be negative.
likely_cause: Length arithmetic produced a negative value.
fix: Validate the requested buffer size before allocation.

title: Malformed hexadecimal input
example_error: bytes.fromhex('0xz1'): ValueError: non-hexadecimal number found in fromhex() arg at position 1
explanation: The text contains invalid hexadecimal characters.
likely_cause: A prefix or unrelated text was included.
fix: Remove an expected 0x prefix and validate hexadecimal digit pairs.

title: Resizing an exported bytearray
example_error: memoryview(buffer); buffer.extend(b'x'): BufferError: Existing exports of data: object cannot be re-sized
explanation: An active view prevents resizing its underlying storage.
likely_cause: A memoryview still references the bytearray.
fix: Release the view before resizing or allocate a separate buffer.

title: Released memoryview access
example_error: view.release(); view[0]: ValueError: operation forbidden on released memoryview object
explanation: A released view no longer exposes storage.
likely_cause: The view outlived its resource scope.
fix: Create a new view while the source buffer is available.

title: Struct buffer too short
example_error: struct.unpack('!I', b'abc'): struct.error: unpack requires a buffer of 4 bytes
explanation: The binary format requires more bytes.
likely_cause: A record was truncated.
fix: Check the record length and accumulate all bytes before unpacking.

title: Struct integer out of bounds
example_error: struct.pack('B', 300): struct.error: ubyte format requires 0 <= number <= 255
explanation: The value does not fit the selected binary field.
likely_cause: An unsigned-byte format was selected for a larger integer.
fix: Choose an appropriate field width or reject the out-of-range value.

title: Struct argument count mismatch
example_error: struct.pack('ii', 1): struct.error: pack expected 2 items for packing (got 1)
explanation: The format and values have different arity.
likely_cause: A required binary field was omitted.
fix: Supply exactly one compatible value for every format field.

title: Invalid Base64 padding
example_error: base64.b64decode('YQ'): binascii.Error: Incorrect padding
explanation: The encoded input lacks required padding.
likely_cause: The payload is truncated or uses an unpadded protocol.
fix: Validate the protocol and restore padding only for a known unpadded encoding.

title: Invalid strict Base64 characters
example_error: base64.b64decode('@@', validate=True): binascii.Error: Only base64 data is allowed
explanation: Strict decoding rejects nonalphabet characters.
likely_cause: The payload contains corruption or the wrong encoding.
fix: Validate the source and select the documented encoding rather than discarding characters.

title: Invalid float text
example_error: float('twelve'): ValueError: could not convert string to float: 'twelve'
explanation: The text is not a floating-point number.
likely_cause: A word or unsupported numeric notation was supplied.
fix: Validate input and use a parser matching its locale and format.

title: Infinite float to integer
example_error: int(float('inf')): OverflowError: cannot convert float infinity to integer
explanation: Infinity has no finite integer representation.
likely_cause: A calculation overflowed or a sentinel reached conversion.
fix: Check math.isfinite and handle nonfinite results before casting.

title: Invalid integer base
example_error: int('10', 1): ValueError: int() base must be >= 2 and <= 36, or 0
explanation: The requested base is unsupported.
likely_cause: Configuration supplied base one.
fix: Use base zero for prefix detection or a supported base from two through 36.

title: Complex to float conversion
example_error: float(1+2j): TypeError: float() argument must be a string or a real number, not 'complex'
explanation: A complex value cannot become a real number implicitly.
likely_cause: Complex arithmetic entered a real-only path.
fix: Choose the real component or magnitude explicitly if mathematically appropriate.

title: Negative bit shift
example_error: 4 << -1: ValueError: negative shift count
explanation: Bit shifts need a nonnegative count.
likely_cause: A computed bit position is negative.
fix: Validate bit positions and choose shift direction separately.

title: Factorial of a negative value
example_error: math.factorial(-2): ValueError: factorial() not defined for negative values
explanation: Integer factorial is defined for nonnegative inputs.
likely_cause: A negative quantity reached factorial.
fix: Reject negative input before evaluating the factorial.

title: Factorial of a noninteger
example_error: math.factorial(2.5): TypeError: 'float' object cannot be interpreted as an integer
explanation: Factorial requires an integer argument.
likely_cause: The caller supplied a fractional value.
fix: Validate integer input; choose a different mathematical function if needed.

title: Fraction denominator zero
example_error: Fraction(3, 0): ZeroDivisionError: Fraction(3, 0)
explanation: A rational number cannot have a zero denominator.
likely_cause: The denominator was not validated.
fix: Reject zero or represent missing/unbounded quantities separately.

title: Decimal mixed with float
example_error: Decimal('1.2') + 0.3: TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'decimal.Decimal' and 'float'
explanation: Decimal and binary floating-point arithmetic are not mixed implicitly.
likely_cause: Inputs use inconsistent numeric types.
fix: Construct all monetary operands from decimal strings or exact integers.

title: Decimal invalid operation
example_error: Decimal('invalid'): decimal.InvalidOperation: ConversionSyntax
explanation: The text is not valid decimal syntax.
likely_cause: An unvalidated token reached Decimal.
fix: Validate text and catch InvalidOperation with a meaningful input error.

title: Impossible calendar date
example_error: date(2025, 2, 30): ValueError: day is out of range for month
explanation: The calendar date does not exist.
likely_cause: The day exceeds the selected month's length.
fix: Validate the source date and avoid approximating months as a fixed day count.

title: Invalid month number
example_error: datetime(2025, 13, 1): ValueError: month must be in 1..12
explanation: Calendar months use values one through twelve.
likely_cause: A zero-based or overflowed month was passed.
fix: Normalize year/month arithmetic before constructing the datetime.

title: Invalid clock hour
example_error: time(24, 0): ValueError: hour must be in 0..23
explanation: Twenty-four is not a valid stored hour.
likely_cause: An end-of-day value was used as a clock time.
fix: Represent midnight as the next day's 00:00.

title: Invalid seconds value
example_error: time(12, 0, 60): ValueError: second must be in 0..59
explanation: The standard datetime type does not encode second sixty.
likely_cause: A leap-second notation reached the constructor.
fix: Use the source protocol's documented normalization or a leap-second-aware library.

title: Strptime leaves trailing data
example_error: datetime.strptime('2025-01-01Z', '%Y-%m-%d'): ValueError: unconverted data remains: Z
explanation: The format consumed only part of the text.
likely_cause: A timezone suffix is not represented in the format.
fix: Parse the full timestamp with a matching format or fromisoformat when applicable.

title: Invalid ISO timestamp
example_error: datetime.fromisoformat('yesterday'): ValueError: Invalid isoformat string: 'yesterday'
explanation: Natural-language dates are not ISO timestamps.
likely_cause: A relative date phrase was passed.
fix: Convert relative phrases deliberately before using an ISO parser.

title: Naive and aware datetime subtraction
example_error: aware - naive: TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes
explanation: Subtraction needs compatible timezone semantics.
likely_cause: One datetime lacks timezone information.
fix: Assign its actual source timezone and convert both values consistently.

title: Datetime and date ordering
example_error: datetime.now() < date.today(): TypeError: can't compare datetime.datetime to datetime.date
explanation: A date and datetime have different comparison semantics.
likely_cause: An application mixed calendar-only and timestamp values.
fix: Compare dates explicitly or convert both operands to compatible datetimes.

title: Missing timezone database
example_error: ZoneInfo('America/New_York'): zoneinfo.ZoneInfoNotFoundError: No time zone found with key America/New_York
explanation: The timezone key cannot be resolved.
likely_cause: The platform lacks IANA timezone data.
fix: Install the supported tzdata package or configure an available timezone database.

title: Timestamp outside platform range
example_error: datetime.fromtimestamp(10**20): OverflowError: timestamp out of range for platform time_t
explanation: The timestamp exceeds platform conversion limits.
likely_cause: Milliseconds or microseconds were mistaken for seconds.
fix: Verify the unit and range before converting the timestamp.

title: JSON set serialization
example_error: json.dumps({'roles': {'reader'}}): TypeError: Object of type set is not JSON serializable
explanation: JSON has arrays but no set type.
likely_cause: A set is present in the response data.
fix: Convert the set to a deterministically ordered list when order matters.

title: JSON bytes serialization
example_error: json.dumps(b'hello'): TypeError: Object of type bytes is not JSON serializable
explanation: JSON requires text-compatible values.
likely_cause: Raw bytes were passed to the encoder.
fix: Decode known text bytes or explicitly Base64-encode binary content.

title: JSON circular reference
example_error: json.dumps(recursive_list): ValueError: Circular reference detected
explanation: JSON cannot represent object-reference cycles.
likely_cause: A container contains itself indirectly or directly.
fix: Remove cycles or serialize references as explicit identifiers.

title: JSON extra documents
example_error: json.loads('{} {}'): JSONDecodeError: Extra data
explanation: The parser expects a single JSON value.
likely_cause: Multiple JSON documents were concatenated.
fix: Parse a documented stream format such as JSON Lines one record at a time.

title: JSON unterminated string
example_error: json.loads('{"x":"open}'): JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at
explanation: The string token has no closing quote.
likely_cause: Input was truncated or quotes were not escaped.
fix: Use a JSON serializer and verify complete transport of the body.

title: JSON invalid control character
example_error: json.loads with literal newline in quoted text: JSONDecodeError: Invalid control character at
explanation: A JSON string contains an unescaped control character.
likely_cause: Raw multiline text was inserted into JSON manually.
fix: Serialize strings with json.dumps rather than assembling JSON fragments.

title: JSON nonstring object key
example_error: json.dumps({(1,2): 3}): TypeError: keys must be str, int, float, bool or None, not tuple
explanation: The key cannot be represented as a JSON object key.
likely_cause: A tuple is used as a mapping key.
fix: Serialize records as arrays or convert keys using a documented reversible convention.

title: JSON rejects nonfinite output
example_error: json.dumps(float('nan'), allow_nan=False): ValueError: Out of range float values are not JSON compliant
explanation: Strict JSON excludes NaN and infinity.
likely_cause: Nonfinite arithmetic output reached serialization.
fix: Replace nonfinite values with a documented null or error representation.

title: JSON loader receives dictionary
example_error: json.loads({'x': 1}): TypeError: the JSON object must be str, bytes or bytearray, not dict
explanation: The loader expects encoded JSON.
likely_cause: Already-decoded data was parsed again.
fix: Use the dictionary directly and decode only at the transport boundary.

title: JSON file object passed to loads
example_error: json.loads(file_handle): TypeError: the JSON object must be str, bytes or bytearray, not TextIOWrapper
explanation: loads expects content, not a file handle.
likely_cause: The file API and string API were confused.
fix: Use json.load(file_handle) within the file's context manager.

title: CSV binary stream input
example_error: csv.reader(binary_file): Error: iterator should return strings, not bytes
explanation: The CSV parser consumes decoded text.
likely_cause: The file was opened in binary mode.
fix: Open with an explicit text encoding and newline=''.

title: CSV field size limit
example_error: csv.reader: Error: field larger than field limit
explanation: A field exceeds the configured parser limit.
likely_cause: A legitimate large field or broken quoting merged many records.
fix: Inspect quoting first; raise csv.field_size_limit only for trusted expected large fields.

title: CSV writer extra dictionary fields
example_error: DictWriter.writerow: ValueError: dict contains fields not in fieldnames
explanation: The record contains undeclared output columns.
likely_cause: Input schema changed without updating fieldnames.
fix: Reconcile fieldnames or deliberately configure extrasaction when discarding fields is intended.

title: CSV escaping disabled
example_error: csv.writer quoting=QUOTE_NONE: Error: need to escape, but no escapechar set
explanation: Special characters cannot be written under the selected rules.
likely_cause: Unquoted output contains a delimiter or newline.
fix: Configure an escape character or enable an appropriate quoting mode.

title: CSV delimiter too long
example_error: csv.reader(delimiter='::'): TypeError: "delimiter" must be a 1-character string
explanation: The standard CSV delimiter is one character.
likely_cause: A multicharacter delimiter was configured.
fix: Use a one-character delimiter or a parser designed for the actual format.

title: CSV dialect cannot be inferred
example_error: csv.Sniffer().sniff(sample): Error: Could not determine delimiter
explanation: The sample does not reveal a reliable dialect.
likely_cause: The sample is empty, short, or irregular.
fix: Provide a known dialect or inspect a representative sample before parsing.

title: CSV dialect name missing
example_error: csv.get_dialect('vendor'): Error: unknown dialect
explanation: The dialect registry lacks that name.
likely_cause: Registration did not occur in this process.
fix: Register the dialect before use or pass formatting parameters explicitly.

title: CSV numeric conversion fails
example_error: csv.reader quoting=QUOTE_NONNUMERIC: ValueError: could not convert string to float: 'name'
explanation: Unquoted fields are being converted to floats.
likely_cause: A header or text column is unquoted.
fix: Handle the header separately or use normal string parsing and explicit column conversion.

title: CSV line endings doubled
example_error: CSV output contains blank lines between records on Windows
explanation: Text newline translation conflicts with CSV's line terminator.
likely_cause: The file was opened without newline=''.
fix: Open the output file with newline='' and an explicit encoding.

title: CSV row returned as one field
example_error: csv.reader returns ['id;name;age']
explanation: The configured delimiter does not split the input.
likely_cause: A semicolon-separated file is parsed as comma-separated.
fix: Set delimiter=';' after verifying the source format.

title: Regex repeat without target
example_error: re.compile('*abc'): re.error: nothing to repeat
explanation: A quantifier has no preceding expression.
likely_cause: A wildcard was written using glob syntax.
fix: Use the proper regex expression or fnmatch for shell-style patterns.

title: Regex unbalanced parenthesis
example_error: re.compile('(abc'): re.error: missing ), unterminated subpattern
explanation: A capture group was not closed.
likely_cause: An opening parenthesis was inserted without its mate.
fix: Balance grouping or escape literal parentheses.

title: Regex bad character range
example_error: re.compile('[z-a]'): re.error: bad character range z-a
explanation: The character interval is reversed.
likely_cause: A dynamically constructed class has descending bounds.
fix: Order range endpoints or escape a literal hyphen.

title: Regex invalid escape
example_error: re.compile(r'\q'): re.error: bad escape \q
explanation: The pattern contains an unsupported escape.
likely_cause: Backslashes were copied from another pattern language.
fix: Use supported regex syntax and raw strings where appropriate.

title: Regex duplicate group name
example_error: re.compile('(?P<x>a)(?P<x>b)'): re.error: redefinition of group name 'x'
explanation: Named groups must be unique.
likely_cause: Two branches reuse the same group identifier.
fix: Use distinct names or combine alternatives inside a single named group.

title: Regex variable-width lookbehind
example_error: re.compile('(?<=a+)b'): re.error: look-behind requires fixed-width pattern
explanation: This engine needs a fixed-width lookbehind.
likely_cause: The lookbehind contains an unbounded repetition.
fix: Restructure using a capture group or lookahead with equivalent semantics.

title: Regex string pattern on bytes
example_error: re.search('word', b'word'): TypeError: cannot use a string pattern on a bytes-like object
explanation: Pattern and input types must match.
likely_cause: Decoded text and binary input were mixed.
fix: Decode the input or use a bytes pattern consistently.

title: Regex bytes pattern on text
example_error: re.search(b'word', 'word'): TypeError: cannot use a bytes pattern on a string-like object
explanation: A bytes pattern cannot search Unicode text.
likely_cause: The pattern was encoded unnecessarily.
fix: Keep both pattern and searched content as text.

title: Regex invalid replacement group
example_error: re.sub('(a)', r'\2', 'a'): re.error: invalid group reference 2
explanation: The replacement references an absent capture group.
likely_cause: The replacement and pattern disagree.
fix: Reference existing groups or use a replacement function.

title: Regex split includes separators
example_error: re.split('(,)', 'a,b') returns ['a', ',', 'b']
explanation: Capturing groups are included in split output.
likely_cause: The delimiter pattern captures its match.
fix: Use a noncapturing group when separators should be discarded.

title: Relative path outside base
example_error: Path('/other/file').relative_to('/project'): ValueError: is not in the subpath
explanation: The path is not beneath the specified base.
likely_cause: Two unrelated absolute roots were compared.
fix: Check containment and handle outside paths explicitly.

title: Invalid empty filename
example_error: Path('/').with_name(''): ValueError: has an empty name
explanation: The path has no replaceable filename.
likely_cause: A filesystem root was treated as a file.
fix: Construct a child path instead of replacing a root's name.

title: Invalid suffix format
example_error: Path('file.txt').with_suffix('csv'): ValueError: Invalid suffix 'csv'
explanation: A nonempty suffix must include its leading dot.
likely_cause: The replacement extension omitted the dot.
fix: Use with_suffix('.csv') or an empty suffix to remove it.

title: Symlink resolution loop
example_error: Path.resolve(): OSError: Too many levels of symbolic links
explanation: The filesystem cannot resolve a cyclic link chain.
likely_cause: Links point back to an ancestor or each other.
fix: Inspect the link chain and repair the cycle before resolving.

title: Cross-device rename
example_error: os.rename(source, destination): OSError: Invalid cross-device link
explanation: Atomic rename cannot cross filesystem boundaries.
likely_cause: Source and destination are on different mounts.
fix: Use a copy-and-remove operation with appropriate failure recovery.

title: Removing a nonempty directory
example_error: Path.rmdir(): OSError: Directory not empty
explanation: rmdir removes only empty directories.
likely_cause: The directory still contains children.
fix: Inspect contents and explicitly remove only files authorized for deletion.

title: Null byte in file path
example_error: open('bad\x00name'): ValueError: embedded null byte
explanation: Filesystem paths cannot contain null characters.
likely_cause: Unvalidated binary or escaped input became a path.
fix: Reject null bytes and validate the path at the input boundary.

title: Path component too long
example_error: open(long_name): OSError: File name too long
explanation: A filename or path exceeds filesystem limits.
likely_cause: A generated name includes excessive source text.
fix: Use a short stable identifier and store descriptive text separately.

title: Invalid path argument type
example_error: Path(42): TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not int
explanation: The path constructor received a number.
likely_cause: An identifier was confused with a filename.
fix: Build a string path deliberately from the identifier.

title: Glob unexpectedly finds no files
example_error: Path.glob('*.CSV') returns no files on a case-sensitive filesystem
explanation: Matching respects the filesystem's case rules.
likely_cause: Extensions use a different case.
fix: Normalize the naming convention or explicitly match the intended cases.

title: Text written to binary stream
example_error: binary_file.write('text'): TypeError: a bytes-like object is required, not 'str'
explanation: The stream accepts bytes.
likely_cause: Text was written without encoding.
fix: Encode with the agreed character encoding or open in text mode.

title: Bytes written to text stream
example_error: text_file.write(b'data'): TypeError: write() argument must be str, not bytes
explanation: The text stream accepts strings.
likely_cause: Binary content reached a text writer.
fix: Use binary mode or decode known textual bytes.

title: Reading a write-only file
example_error: open('out.txt', 'w').read(): io.UnsupportedOperation: not readable
explanation: The selected mode does not permit reading.
likely_cause: A writer is reused as a reader.
fix: Open with a suitable read/write mode or reopen after writing.

title: Writing a read-only stream
example_error: open('in.txt').write('x'): io.UnsupportedOperation: not writable
explanation: The selected mode does not permit writing.
likely_cause: A read handle was used to modify content.
fix: Open an intended writable destination with the correct mode.

title: Seeking a nonseekable stream
example_error: sys.stdin.seek(0): io.UnsupportedOperation: underlying stream is not seekable
explanation: Pipes and some streams cannot rewind.
likely_cause: Code assumes every input is a regular file.
fix: Process incrementally or explicitly buffer a bounded amount of data.

title: Unknown text encoding
example_error: open('data.txt', encoding='utf-99'): LookupError: unknown encoding: utf-99
explanation: The codec registry cannot resolve the encoding.
likely_cause: A name is misspelled or unsupported.
fix: Use the source's documented supported encoding name.

title: Incomplete input prompt
example_error: input(): EOFError: EOF when reading a line
explanation: The input stream ended before a line was available.
likely_cause: Interactive code ran with closed or redirected stdin.
fix: Accept arguments or handle EOF explicitly in noninteractive execution.

title: Temporary file reopened on Windows
example_error: NamedTemporaryFile reopen: PermissionError: sharing violation
explanation: The original temporary handle prevents a second open under its sharing settings.
likely_cause: The file remains open while another library opens it.
fix: Use documented temporary-file options or close the handle before handing off the path.

title: Read into immutable buffer
example_error: stream.readinto(b'xxxx'): TypeError: readinto() argument must be read-write bytes-like object
explanation: readinto needs writable storage.
likely_cause: An immutable bytes object was supplied.
fix: Allocate a bytearray of the required size.

title: Invalid file mode combination
example_error: open('data', 'rw'): ValueError: must have exactly one of create/read/write/append mode
explanation: The file mode string combines incompatible primary modes.
likely_cause: Read and write flags were concatenated incorrectly.
fix: Use r+ for existing read/write files or w+ when truncation is intended.

title: Invalid ZIP archive
example_error: ZipFile('download.zip'): BadZipFile: File is not a zip file
explanation: The content is not a readable ZIP container.
likely_cause: An HTML download response or corrupt file was saved.
fix: Check HTTP status and content before opening and obtain a complete archive.

title: ZIP member absent
example_error: archive.read('manifest.json'): KeyError: There is no item named 'manifest.json' in the archive
explanation: The requested archive member does not exist.
likely_cause: The member path differs from the assumed name.
fix: Inspect namelist and select the exact member path.

title: Encrypted ZIP needs password
example_error: archive.read('secret.txt'): RuntimeError: File is encrypted, password required for extraction
explanation: The member is password-protected.
likely_cause: No password was supplied.
fix: Obtain the legitimate password and pass it through the supported password API.

title: Wrong ZIP password
example_error: archive.read('secret.txt', pwd=b'wrong'): RuntimeError: Bad password for file
explanation: The supplied password does not decrypt the member.
likely_cause: The password is incorrect.
fix: Verify the password through the archive owner and retry without logging it.

title: ZIP CRC mismatch
example_error: ZipFile.testzip(): BadZipFile: Bad CRC-32 for file
explanation: The member checksum does not match its content.
likely_cause: The archive was corrupted or incompletely transferred.
fix: Download or regenerate the archive and verify its checksum.

title: Closed ZIP operation
example_error: archive.close(); archive.read('x'): ValueError: Attempt to use ZIP archive that was already closed
explanation: The archive handle is no longer usable.
likely_cause: A read occurs after the with block.
fix: Read members while the archive context is active.

title: Invalid gzip input
example_error: gzip.open('data.gz').read(): BadGzipFile: Not a gzipped file
explanation: The stream lacks a valid gzip format.
likely_cause: The extension does not match the content.
fix: Inspect the source and use the correct decompressor or plain reader.

title: Truncated gzip stream
example_error: gzip.decompress(data): EOFError: Compressed file ended before the end-of-stream marker was reached
explanation: The compressed stream is incomplete.
likely_cause: A transfer or write stopped early.
fix: Obtain the full compressed payload before decompressing.

title: Tar extraction path rejected
example_error: tarfile.extractall(filter='data'): OutsideDestinationError
explanation: An archive member would escape the destination.
likely_cause: The archive contains traversal paths.
fix: Keep the safe extraction filter and reject or inspect the unsafe archive.

title: Invalid tar header
example_error: tarfile.open('backup.tar'): ReadError: file could not be opened successfully
explanation: No supported tar reader accepts the input.
likely_cause: The file is corrupt or uses another archive format.
fix: Check actual compression and archive format before choosing the reader.

title: Pickle input truncated
example_error: pickle.load(file): UnpicklingError: pickle data was truncated
explanation: The serialized record ended unexpectedly.
likely_cause: The file was partially written or transferred.
fix: Restore a complete trusted artifact and write future artifacts atomically.

title: Pickle unknown module
example_error: pickle.load(file): ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'old_package'
explanation: Deserialization needs the original importable class module.
likely_cause: The package was renamed or omitted.
fix: Restore compatible trusted code or migrate the artifact in its original environment.

title: Pickle class attribute missing
example_error: pickle.load(file): AttributeError: Can't get attribute 'CustomType'
explanation: The saved class cannot be found at its recorded location.
likely_cause: The class moved or was defined only in a script session.
fix: Keep serialization classes in stable importable modules and rebuild trusted artifacts.

title: Pickle unsupported protocol
example_error: pickle.load(file): ValueError: unsupported pickle protocol
explanation: The reader does not understand the artifact protocol.
likely_cause: A newer interpreter created the file.
fix: Use a compatible Python version or re-export with a supported protocol.

title: Pickle text-mode file
example_error: pickle.dump(data, text_file): TypeError: write() argument must be str, not bytes
explanation: Pickle writes binary data.
likely_cause: The output file was opened in text mode.
fix: Open the artifact with wb and load it with rb.

title: Empty pickle file
example_error: pickle.load(empty_file): EOFError: Ran out of input
explanation: No serialized object is available.
likely_cause: A failed build left an empty artifact.
fix: Validate artifact creation and load only after successful completion.

title: Thread lock cannot be pickled
example_error: pickle.dumps(threading.Lock()): TypeError: cannot pickle '_thread.lock' object
explanation: A process-local synchronization primitive is not serializable.
likely_cause: An object includes an active lock.
fix: Exclude the lock from serialized state and recreate it during initialization.

title: Generator cannot be pickled
example_error: pickle.dumps(generator): TypeError: cannot pickle 'generator' object
explanation: A live generator's execution state is not portable through pickle.
likely_cause: A lazy iterator was submitted as process data.
fix: Serialize its inputs or a bounded materialized result instead.

title: Open file cannot be pickled
example_error: pickle.dumps(file_handle): TypeError: cannot pickle '_io.TextIOWrapper' object
explanation: An open file handle is process-local.
likely_cause: An object graph includes a live stream.
fix: Pass a file path and reopen it in the receiving process.

title: Invalid pickle opcode
example_error: pickle.loads(untrusted_bytes): UnpicklingError: invalid load key
explanation: The input is not valid pickle data.
likely_cause: A different format or corrupt payload was loaded.
fix: Validate artifact provenance and format; never deserialize untrusted pickle input.

title: SQLite table missing
example_error: sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table: orders
explanation: The database schema lacks the queried table.
likely_cause: Migrations were not applied or the wrong database file opened.
fix: Verify the absolute database path and apply the intended schema migration.

title: SQLite column missing
example_error: sqlite3.OperationalError: no such column: total
explanation: The query references an unavailable column.
likely_cause: Code and database schema versions differ.
fix: Inspect table_info and migrate or correct the selected column.

title: SQLite database locked
example_error: sqlite3.OperationalError: database is locked
explanation: A transaction cannot obtain the required lock.
likely_cause: Another connection holds a long write transaction.
fix: Shorten transactions, close leaked connections, and use bounded busy timeouts.

title: SQLite unique constraint
example_error: sqlite3.IntegrityError: UNIQUE constraint failed: users.email
explanation: The inserted value duplicates a unique key.
likely_cause: An existing email is inserted again.
fix: Check intended upsert semantics and handle duplicate identities explicitly.

title: SQLite foreign key violation
example_error: sqlite3.IntegrityError: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed
explanation: A referenced parent key does not exist or remains in use.
likely_cause: Child and parent writes occur in an invalid order.
fix: Maintain the relationship within a transaction and keep foreign-key enforcement enabled.

title: SQLite null constraint
example_error: sqlite3.IntegrityError: NOT NULL constraint failed: orders.customer_id
explanation: A required column received NULL.
likely_cause: The application omitted its required value.
fix: Validate required data or define a meaningful schema default.

title: SQLite binding count mismatch
example_error: sqlite3.ProgrammingError: Incorrect number of bindings supplied
explanation: SQL placeholders and bound parameters have different counts.
likely_cause: A string was passed instead of a one-item tuple.
fix: Pass (value,) for one positional parameter and match every placeholder.

title: SQLite cross-thread connection
example_error: sqlite3.ProgrammingError: SQLite objects created in a thread can only be used in that same thread
explanation: The connection enforces its creating-thread affinity.
likely_cause: A shared connection is used by another worker.
fix: Create a connection per worker or deliberately manage supported synchronized access.

title: SQLite closed connection
example_error: sqlite3.ProgrammingError: Cannot operate on a closed database
explanation: The connection lifecycle already ended.
likely_cause: A cursor outlived its connection scope.
fix: Perform operations before closing and create a fresh connection when needed.

title: SQLite syntax near keyword
example_error: sqlite3.OperationalError: near "FROM": syntax error
explanation: The SQL statement cannot be parsed.
likely_cause: A comma or clause is missing before FROM.
fix: Inspect the assembled SQL and bind values instead of interpolating them.

title: Awaiting a plain value
example_error: await 42: TypeError: object int can't be used in 'await' expression
explanation: Only awaitable objects can be awaited.
likely_cause: A synchronous helper returned an integer.
fix: Call the synchronous helper normally or expose a genuine coroutine.

title: Reusing an awaited coroutine
example_error: await same_coroutine twice: RuntimeError: cannot reuse already awaited coroutine
explanation: A coroutine object runs only once.
likely_cause: The same coroutine instance was stored and awaited again.
fix: Call the async function again or share a Task when one execution should be reused.

title: Awaiting self task
example_error: RuntimeError: Task cannot await on itself
explanation: A task depends directly on its own completion.
likely_cause: Task references were mixed up.
fix: Separate producer and waiter tasks and remove the self dependency.

title: Future belongs to another loop
example_error: RuntimeError: Task got Future attached to a different loop
explanation: The future is owned by another event loop.
likely_cause: Async resources were created globally or reused across runners.
fix: Create and use resources within one application event-loop lifecycle.

title: Event loop closed
example_error: RuntimeError: Event loop is closed
explanation: Work was scheduled after loop shutdown.
likely_cause: Cleanup order leaves callbacks using the closed loop.
fix: Finish and close async resources before the loop terminates.

title: Task result read too soon
example_error: task.result(): asyncio.InvalidStateError: Result is not set
explanation: The task has not completed.
likely_cause: Code requests a synchronous result immediately after scheduling.
fix: Await the task or check done before reading its result.

title: Async task cancellation
example_error: await task: asyncio.CancelledError
explanation: The task was cancelled cooperatively.
likely_cause: Shutdown or a timeout cancelled pending work.
fix: Use finally for cleanup and propagate cancellation unless intentionally managing it.

title: Async queue has no item
example_error: queue.get_nowait(): asyncio.QueueEmpty
explanation: Nonblocking retrieval found no queued item.
likely_cause: The producer has not supplied work.
fix: Await queue.get or handle QueueEmpty without a busy loop.

title: Async queue capacity exhausted
example_error: queue.put_nowait(item): asyncio.QueueFull
explanation: The bounded queue cannot accept another item.
likely_cause: Producers outpace consumers.
fix: Await queue.put for backpressure or define a deliberate drop policy.

title: Async queue completion overcount
example_error: queue.task_done(): ValueError: task_done() called too many times
explanation: Completion acknowledgments exceed retrieved tasks.
likely_cause: A task is acknowledged twice.
fix: Call task_done exactly once per successful get, usually in finally.

title: Starting a thread twice
example_error: thread.start(): RuntimeError: threads can only be started once
explanation: A Thread instance represents one execution.
likely_cause: A finished instance was restarted.
fix: Create a new Thread object for another execution.

title: Joining an unstarted thread
example_error: thread.join(): RuntimeError: cannot join thread before it is started
explanation: The thread has no active execution to wait for.
likely_cause: Join occurs before start.
fix: Start the thread first and track its lifecycle explicitly.

title: Thread joins itself
example_error: RuntimeError: cannot join current thread
explanation: A thread cannot wait for its own termination.
likely_cause: A cleanup routine includes the calling thread.
fix: Join only other threads from the coordinating thread.

title: Releasing an unlocked lock
example_error: lock.release(): RuntimeError: release unlocked lock
explanation: The primitive lock is not held.
likely_cause: Cleanup releases a lock that was never acquired.
fix: Use a with block or track successful acquisition before release.

title: Condition wait without lock
example_error: condition.wait(): RuntimeError: cannot wait on un-acquired lock
explanation: Condition waiting requires ownership of its lock.
likely_cause: wait was called outside the condition context.
fix: Enter with condition before testing the predicate and waiting.

title: Condition notify without lock
example_error: condition.notify(): RuntimeError: cannot notify on un-acquired lock
explanation: Notification requires holding the associated lock.
likely_cause: State updates and notification occur outside synchronization.
fix: Modify shared state and notify inside with condition.

title: Broken synchronization barrier
example_error: barrier.wait(): threading.BrokenBarrierError
explanation: The barrier cannot complete its participant rendezvous.
likely_cause: A peer timed out, aborted, or failed.
fix: Handle the failed group and create/reset the barrier only after coordinating all participants.

title: Bounded semaphore released too often
example_error: semaphore.release(): ValueError: Semaphore released too many times
explanation: Releases exceeded the configured capacity.
likely_cause: A finally block released without successful acquisition.
fix: Pair each acquire with exactly one release or use the semaphore context manager.

title: Thread queue empty
example_error: queue.Queue().get_nowait(): queue.Empty
explanation: The thread-safe queue currently holds no items.
likely_cause: A consumer runs before its producer.
fix: Use blocking get with an appropriate timeout or handle Empty.

title: Thread queue full
example_error: bounded_queue.put_nowait(item): queue.Full
explanation: The queue reached its maximum size.
likely_cause: The producer outpaces consumers.
fix: Use blocking put with timeout or an explicit overflow strategy.

title: Process pool worker died
example_error: concurrent.futures.process.BrokenProcessPool
explanation: A worker terminated before returning a result.
likely_cause: A native crash, forced exit, or memory limit killed it.
fix: Inspect worker logs and resource limits; isolate the failing input.

title: Executor used after shutdown
example_error: executor.submit(work): RuntimeError: cannot schedule new futures after shutdown
explanation: The executor no longer accepts work.
likely_cause: Submission occurs outside its context manager.
fix: Submit within the executor lifecycle or create a new executor.

title: Future result timeout
example_error: future.result(timeout=1): concurrent.futures.TimeoutError
explanation: The result was not ready by the deadline.
likely_cause: The worker takes longer than expected.
fix: Inspect progress and select a bounded timeout appropriate to the workload.

title: Future cancelled before result
example_error: future.result(): concurrent.futures.CancelledError
explanation: The future was cancelled before completion.
likely_cause: The coordinator cancelled pending work.
fix: Handle cancellation separately from computation failures.

title: Daemon process starts child
example_error: multiprocessing.Process.start(): AssertionError: daemonic processes are not allowed to have children
explanation: A daemon worker cannot spawn another process.
likely_cause: Nested multiprocessing is attempted inside daemon workers.
fix: Move process orchestration to the main process or avoid nested pools.

title: Process target arguments not iterable
example_error: Process(target=worker, args=5): TypeError: argument after * must be an iterable
explanation: Process arguments are expanded as a sequence.
likely_cause: A scalar was supplied for args.
fix: Pass args=(5,) for one argument.

title: Process authentication rejected
example_error: multiprocessing.connection.AuthenticationError: digest received was wrong
explanation: The connection authentication keys differ.
likely_cause: Client and server use different authkeys.
fix: Configure matching authorized keys without exposing them in logs.

title: Manager proxy connection lost
example_error: manager_proxy: EOFError while reading response
explanation: The manager process closed its connection.
likely_cause: The manager context ended before proxy use.
fix: Keep the manager alive until all proxy operations finish.

title: Shared memory segment absent
example_error: SharedMemory(name='segment'): FileNotFoundError
explanation: The named shared-memory object does not exist.
likely_cause: It was unlinked or never created in this environment.
fix: Coordinate creation and unlink only after all consumers finish.

title: Shared memory still exported
example_error: shared_memory.close(): BufferError: cannot close exported pointers exist
explanation: Views still reference the mapped memory.
likely_cause: A memoryview or array outlived its intended scope.
fix: Release dependent views before closing the shared-memory handle.

title: DNS name cannot resolve
example_error: socket.gaierror: Name or service not known
explanation: The resolver cannot map the hostname to an address.
likely_cause: The hostname is misspelled or DNS is unavailable.
fix: Verify the hostname and system DNS configuration.

title: Network route unavailable
example_error: OSError: Network is unreachable
explanation: The system has no route to the target network.
likely_cause: The interface, VPN, or route configuration is unavailable.
fix: Restore the intended network path and retry within bounded limits.

title: Host unreachable
example_error: OSError: No route to host
explanation: The destination cannot be reached through the current route.
likely_cause: A gateway, firewall, or remote host blocks traffic.
fix: Verify the host and routing with the network administrator.

title: TLS hostname mismatch
example_error: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: certificate is not valid for hostname
explanation: The certificate does not identify the requested host.
likely_cause: The URL uses the wrong hostname or the server certificate is misconfigured.
fix: Use the legitimate hostname and repair certificate configuration; keep verification enabled.

title: TLS protocol mismatch
example_error: ssl.SSLError: WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER
explanation: The TLS handshake received incompatible protocol data.
likely_cause: HTTPS was used against a plain HTTP port.
fix: Verify the endpoint scheme and TLS listener port.

title: TLS handshake ended early
example_error: ssl.SSLEOFError: EOF occurred in violation of protocol
explanation: The peer closed during TLS communication.
likely_cause: A proxy or server terminated the handshake.
fix: Inspect proxy/server logs and compatible TLS configuration.

title: Socket already closed
example_error: socket.send(): OSError: Bad file descriptor
explanation: The socket handle is invalid.
likely_cause: A connection was closed before writing.
fix: Coordinate connection ownership and avoid reuse after close.

title: Invalid IP address text
example_error: ipaddress.ip_address('999.1.1.1'): ValueError: does not appear to be an IPv4 or IPv6 address
explanation: The address does not match a valid IP representation.
likely_cause: A segment is out of range.
fix: Validate address input and keep hostnames separate from literal IP addresses.

title: Network prefix has host bits
example_error: ipaddress.ip_network('192.0.2.3/24'): ValueError: has host bits set
explanation: Strict network parsing requires the network address.
likely_cause: A host address was supplied with a subnet prefix.
fix: Use the actual network address or strict=False when intentional normalization is desired.

title: HTTP server closes response early
example_error: http.client.IncompleteRead
explanation: The response body ended before its declared length.
likely_cause: The server or intermediary interrupted the transfer.
fix: Check transport/server failures and retry only safe requests.

title: Subprocess executable missing
example_error: subprocess.run(['missing-tool']): FileNotFoundError
explanation: The operating system cannot locate the program.
likely_cause: The executable is absent or not on PATH.
fix: Install the approved tool or supply its verified absolute path.

title: Subprocess executable denied
example_error: subprocess.run(['./tool']): PermissionError
explanation: The process cannot execute the selected file.
likely_cause: Execute permission is absent or the file is blocked by policy.
fix: Use an approved executable and correct its documented permissions.

title: Subprocess invalid executable format
example_error: subprocess.run(['./tool']): OSError: Exec format error
explanation: The file cannot run as a native executable.
likely_cause: It targets another architecture or lacks a required interpreter header.
fix: Use a compatible binary or invoke the correct interpreter explicitly.

title: Subprocess pipe deadlock
example_error: Popen.wait() hangs with stdout=PIPE
explanation: The child blocks on a full output pipe.
likely_cause: The parent waits without draining output.
fix: Use communicate or continuously consume both stdout and stderr.

title: Subprocess input type mismatch
example_error: subprocess.run(input='hello'): TypeError: memoryview: a bytes-like object is required
explanation: Binary communication expects bytes.
likely_cause: Text input was supplied without text mode.
fix: Set text=True with an encoding or pass encoded bytes.

title: Shell wildcard is literal
example_error: subprocess.run(['ls', '*.csv']) cannot find '*.csv'
explanation: Argument-list execution does not perform shell glob expansion.
likely_cause: A shell pattern was passed as a filename.
fix: Expand files using pathlib/glob and pass the resulting paths as arguments.

title: Environment value is not text
example_error: Popen(env={'PORT': 8000}): TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not int
explanation: Process environment values must be string-like.
likely_cause: A numeric setting was inserted directly.
fix: Convert environment values to strings deliberately.

title: Subprocess working directory missing
example_error: Popen(command, cwd='/missing'): FileNotFoundError
explanation: The child cannot enter its working directory.
likely_cause: The cwd path does not exist.
fix: Create or correct the intended working directory before launching.

title: Subprocess unexpected shell expansion
example_error: Shell command treats user filename as command substitution
explanation: The shell interprets metacharacters in input.
likely_cause: Untrusted data was interpolated into shell text.
fix: Pass an argument list with shell=False and avoid building shell expressions.

title: Subprocess output decoding fails
example_error: subprocess.run(text=True): UnicodeDecodeError decoding stdout
explanation: The chosen encoding does not match the child output.
likely_cause: The child emits another encoding or binary data.
fix: Capture bytes or specify the documented output encoding.

title: Parent-relative import beyond root
example_error: ImportError: attempted relative import beyond top-level package
explanation: The relative import climbs above the package root.
likely_cause: Too many leading dots were used.
fix: Correct the package-relative path or use the proper absolute import.

title: Namespace package missing location
example_error: package.__file__ is None for a namespace package
explanation: Namespace packages need not have one file location.
likely_cause: Code assumes every package maps to an __init__.py file.
fix: Use importlib.resources for package data or inspect package search locations deliberately.

title: Importlib spec has no loader
example_error: spec.loader.exec_module: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'exec_module'
explanation: No executable loader was created for the path.
likely_cause: The file type or spec construction is unsupported.
fix: Check spec and loader before executing a supported Python module.

title: Package metadata absent
example_error: importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError: No package metadata was found
explanation: The distribution is not installed under that name.
likely_cause: An import name was confused with a distribution name.
fix: Query the installed distribution name in the active environment.

title: Optional extension cannot load
example_error: ImportError: DLL load failed while importing extension
explanation: A compiled extension's shared dependency cannot be loaded.
likely_cause: Architecture, runtime, or dependent library versions differ.
fix: Install a compatible wheel and its documented runtime dependencies.

title: Extension undefined symbol
example_error: ImportError: undefined symbol while importing compiled module
explanation: The binary expects a symbol unavailable in loaded libraries.
likely_cause: An extension was built against an incompatible ABI.
fix: Reinstall matching binary dependencies in a clean environment.

title: Package resource missing
example_error: importlib.resources.files(...).joinpath(...).read_text(): FileNotFoundError
explanation: The installed package lacks the requested resource.
likely_cause: Build configuration excluded data files.
fix: Include the resource in package data and rebuild the distribution.

title: Module cache keeps old code
example_error: Edited module still has previous values after import
explanation: Repeated import reuses sys.modules.
likely_cause: A running process retains the earlier module.
fix: Restart the process; use reload cautiously when object references and state are understood.

title: Import side effect runs twice
example_error: Module initialization executes once as __main__ and once by package name
explanation: The same source has two module identities.
likely_cause: A script is both executed directly and imported.
fix: Use a package entrypoint and place executable work under the main guard.

title: Incorrect sys.path priority
example_error: Import resolves to an unintended installed package version
explanation: The earlier search path wins.
likely_cause: A custom sys.path entry shadows the intended environment.
fix: Inspect module.__file__ and remove unintended path injection.

title: Abstract class instantiated
example_error: TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class Worker without an implementation for abstract method run
explanation: Abstract methods remain unimplemented.
likely_cause: A subclass omits a required method.
fix: Implement every abstract contract before constructing the subclass.

title: Read-only property assignment
example_error: AttributeError: property 'name' of 'User' object has no setter
explanation: The property exposes no assignment operation.
likely_cause: Code assigns to a computed read-only property.
fix: Use the intended mutation method or define a setter with validation.

title: Slots reject new attribute
example_error: AttributeError: 'Point' object has no attribute 'color' with __slots__
explanation: The instance cannot store undeclared attributes.
likely_cause: The class restricts its attribute layout.
fix: Declare the slot or keep auxiliary data outside the instance.

title: Super called outside instance context
example_error: RuntimeError: super(): no arguments
explanation: Zero-argument super lacks the needed method context.
likely_cause: It is called from a nested or ordinary function.
fix: Call super inside the appropriate method or provide explicit supported class/instance arguments.

title: Super instance mismatch
example_error: TypeError: super(type, obj): obj must be an instance or subtype of type
explanation: The supplied class and object are unrelated.
likely_cause: A copied method refers to the wrong class.
fix: Correct the inheritance relationship and use zero-argument super in normal methods.

title: Invalid constructor return
example_error: TypeError: __init__() should return None, not 'int'
explanation: Initialization cannot return a replacement object.
likely_cause: __init__ returns a computed value.
fix: Store state on self and return no value from __init__.

title: Invalid string special method
example_error: TypeError: __str__ returned non-string
explanation: String conversion must return text.
likely_cause: __str__ returns a number or None.
fix: Return a string representation explicitly.

title: Invalid length special method
example_error: ValueError: __len__() should return >= 0
explanation: Container length cannot be negative.
likely_cause: Custom length arithmetic produces a negative result.
fix: Ensure __len__ returns the actual nonnegative item count.

title: Unorderable custom objects
example_error: sorted(objects): TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of 'Record' and 'Record'
explanation: The objects do not define ordering.
likely_cause: Sorting lacks a meaningful comparison key.
fix: Pass key=lambda record: record.field with the desired ordering.

title: Inconsistent inheritance order
example_error: TypeError: Cannot create a consistent method resolution order
explanation: The bases impose conflicting inheritance precedence.
likely_cause: Multiple inheritance combines incompatible base orders.
fix: Simplify the hierarchy or use a consistent base ordering.

title: Mutable dataclass default
example_error: ValueError: mutable default for field items is not allowed: use default_factory
explanation: Each instance needs its own mutable default.
likely_cause: A list or dictionary is declared directly as a field default.
fix: Use field(default_factory=list) or the appropriate factory.

title: Dataclass required field follows optional
example_error: TypeError: non-default argument 'name' follows default argument
explanation: Generated initializer parameters have invalid ordering.
likely_cause: A required field follows a defaulted field, possibly through inheritance.
fix: Reorder fields or make the appropriate fields keyword-only.

title: Frozen dataclass assignment
example_error: dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError: cannot assign to field 'count'
explanation: The dataclass blocks normal mutation.
likely_cause: Code modifies a frozen instance.
fix: Create an updated instance with dataclasses.replace.

title: Dataclass utility on wrong object
example_error: dataclasses.asdict(value): TypeError: asdict() should be called on dataclass instances
explanation: The function requires a dataclass instance.
likely_cause: A class or ordinary object was supplied.
fix: Pass an instance or use the serializer appropriate to the actual type.

title: Named tuple wrong arity
example_error: Point(1): TypeError: Point.__new__() missing required positional argument
explanation: The named tuple requires every nondefault field.
likely_cause: Construction omitted a field.
fix: Provide all required values or define deliberate defaults.

title: Named tuple field starts underscore
example_error: ValueError: Field names cannot start with an underscore
explanation: Named tuple field names have restrictions.
likely_cause: External column names were reused directly.
fix: Sanitize the field names or use a dictionary for unrestricted labels.

title: Enum value not declared
example_error: Color('purple'): ValueError: 'purple' is not a valid Color
explanation: The value is outside the enum's members.
likely_cause: Input contains an unsupported option.
fix: Validate against accepted enum values and report the permitted choices.

title: Enum name not declared
example_error: Color['PURPLE']: KeyError: 'PURPLE'
explanation: Lookup by member name found no match.
likely_cause: A value string was confused with a member name.
fix: Use Enum(value) for value lookup or the exact declared name.

title: Enum members cannot be extended
example_error: TypeError: cannot extend enumeration
explanation: An enum with members cannot gain members through subclassing.
likely_cause: Inheritance was used to append options.
fix: Define a new complete enum or separate reusable behavior from member definitions.

title: Cached property lacks instance dictionary
example_error: TypeError: No '__dict__' attribute on instance to cache property
explanation: cached_property stores its result in the instance dictionary.
likely_cause: A slots-only class has no __dict__.
fix: Provide supported storage or use a different explicit caching strategy.

title: Range step zero
example_error: range(0, 10, 0): ValueError: range() arg 3 must not be zero
explanation: The range cannot advance with a zero step.
likely_cause: Step configuration is zero.
fix: Validate a nonzero step before constructing the range.

title: Range receives float
example_error: range(2.5): TypeError: 'float' object cannot be interpreted as an integer
explanation: Range counts integer positions.
likely_cause: A fractional count was supplied.
fix: Validate an integer count or use a numerical sequence generator for fractions.

title: Next on a list
example_error: next([1, 2]): TypeError: 'list' object is not an iterator
explanation: next requires an iterator rather than a general iterable.
likely_cause: The list was not wrapped with iter.
fix: Call next(iter(values), default) or use ordinary iteration.

title: Generator ignores close
example_error: RuntimeError: generator ignored GeneratorExit
explanation: The generator yielded while being closed.
likely_cause: Cleanup code yields from finally.
fix: Release resources without yielding when GeneratorExit is raised.

title: Generator StopIteration escapes
example_error: RuntimeError: generator raised StopIteration
explanation: An internal StopIteration escaped a generator body.
likely_cause: next exhausted a nested iterator without a default.
fix: Use return to finish the generator or handle nested exhaustion explicitly.

title: Generator already executing
example_error: ValueError: generator already executing
explanation: A generator cannot be resumed reentrantly.
likely_cause: The generator is recursively entered or shared unsafely.
fix: Serialize access or create independent generator instances.

title: Sending to a fresh generator
example_error: TypeError: can't send non-None value to a just-started generator
explanation: The generator has not reached its first yield.
likely_cause: send(value) precedes initial advancement.
fix: Prime it with next or send(None) before sending a value.

title: Islice negative index
example_error: itertools.islice(values, -1): ValueError: Stop argument for islice() must be None or an integer
explanation: islice does not support negative positional bounds.
likely_cause: List-style negative indexing was applied to an iterator.
fix: Use supported nonnegative bounds or materialize a bounded sequence when necessary.

title: Tee buffering grows memory
example_error: itertools.tee consumers cause memory growth
explanation: Items are buffered until every clone catches up.
likely_cause: One cloned iterator lags far behind.
fix: Consume clones together or choose bounded independent processing.

title: Exhausted map reused
example_error: Second iteration over map produces no results
explanation: map returns a single-pass iterator.
likely_cause: The same lazy result is consumed twice.
fix: Recreate the map or materialize it once if reuse is required.

title: Object lacks context manager support
example_error: with resource: TypeError: object does not support the context manager protocol
explanation: The object does not implement entry and exit operations.
likely_cause: An ordinary object was used in a with statement.
fix: Use the documented lifecycle API or implement the context manager protocol.

title: Async context used with sync with
example_error: with async_resource: TypeError: object does not support the context manager protocol
explanation: The resource exposes asynchronous entry and exit.
likely_cause: An async context manager was entered synchronously.
fix: Use async with from an async function.

title: Sync context used with async with
example_error: async with file_handle: TypeError: object does not support the asynchronous context manager protocol
explanation: A regular file is not an async context manager.
likely_cause: Synchronous I/O was treated as asynchronous.
fix: Use a normal with block and offload blocking work when needed.

title: Contextmanager function returns scalar
example_error: contextlib.contextmanager factory: TypeError: 'int' object is not an iterator
explanation: The decorator expects a generator function.
likely_cause: The function returns a value without yielding.
fix: Yield the resource once and perform cleanup afterward.

title: Context resource not yielded
example_error: contextlib.contextmanager: RuntimeError: generator didn't yield
explanation: The context manager ended before providing a resource.
likely_cause: A conditional branch returns before yield.
fix: Raise a meaningful setup error or yield exactly once on every successful path.

title: Context generator yields repeatedly
example_error: contextlib.contextmanager: RuntimeError: generator didn't stop
explanation: The context manager continued yielding during exit.
likely_cause: A loop yields multiple resources.
fix: Use one yield per context entry and iterate outside the context manager.

title: ExitStack used after premature close
example_error: Managed resource is closed before ExitStack work completes
explanation: The stack already ran its cleanup callbacks.
likely_cause: close was called before dependent work finished.
fix: Keep all dependent work within the ExitStack context.

title: Exception suppressed unintentionally
example_error: Exception disappears after leaving custom context manager
explanation: A truthy __exit__ return suppresses the exception.
likely_cause: Cleanup returns True unconditionally.
fix: Return False or None unless suppressing that specific exception is intentional.

title: Context variable missing value
example_error: ContextVar.get(): LookupError
explanation: No value exists in the current context.
likely_cause: Initialization happened only in another task/context.
fix: Set a default or initialize the variable in the current request context.

title: Context token reset twice
example_error: ContextVar.reset(token): RuntimeError: Token has already been used once
explanation: A token restores its prior state only once.
likely_cause: Cleanup reuses an already-reset token.
fix: Pair each set with one reset in the matching context.

title: Logging format argument mismatch
example_error: logger.info('value', value): TypeError: not all arguments converted during string formatting
explanation: Logging positional arguments interpolate percent placeholders.
likely_cause: The format string contains no matching placeholder.
fix: Use logger.info('value=%s', value) for deferred formatting.

title: Logging missing format field
example_error: ValueError: Formatting field not found in record: 'request_id'
explanation: The formatter requires metadata missing from the record.
likely_cause: Not every logger path supplies the custom field.
fix: Provide a filter/default or ensure all records supply the field.

title: Logging reserved extra key
example_error: KeyError: Attempt to overwrite 'message' in LogRecord
explanation: extra cannot replace reserved logging attributes.
likely_cause: A custom payload uses a reserved key.
fix: Rename the custom field to a nonreserved attribute.

title: Logging file directory missing
example_error: FileHandler('logs/app.log'): FileNotFoundError
explanation: The handler cannot create missing parent directories.
likely_cause: The logs folder was never created.
fix: Create the intended directory before constructing the file handler.

title: Logging duplicate messages
example_error: One logger call appears twice in output
explanation: The record is handled multiple times.
likely_cause: Handlers exist on both child and ancestor loggers with propagation.
fix: Configure handlers once and set propagation deliberately.

title: Logging basicConfig has no effect
example_error: basicConfig(level=DEBUG) leaves existing log level unchanged
explanation: An existing root handler prevents default configuration.
likely_cause: Another module configured logging first.
fix: Configure logging at startup or explicitly reconfigure known handlers.

title: Argparse required option absent
example_error: argparse: error: the following arguments are required: --input
explanation: Command-line validation found missing required input.
likely_cause: The invocation omits a mandatory option.
fix: Supply the documented flag and its value.

title: Argparse unknown option
example_error: argparse: error: unrecognized arguments: --ouput
explanation: The parser does not declare that option.
likely_cause: The option name is misspelled.
fix: Check --help and correct the flag spelling.

title: Argparse integer conversion
example_error: argparse: error: argument --count: invalid int value: 'many'
explanation: The argument cannot be converted to an integer.
likely_cause: Nonnumeric text was supplied.
fix: Pass an integer or change the parser contract if text is intended.

title: Argparse option missing value
example_error: argparse: error: argument --output: expected one argument
explanation: The option requires a following value.
likely_cause: The command ends after the flag.
fix: Provide the filename and quote it properly when it contains spaces.

title: Unittest discovery finds no tests
example_error: python -m unittest discover: Ran 0 tests
explanation: Discovery did not locate matching importable tests.
likely_cause: Names or start directory do not follow discovery rules.
fix: Use test*.py modules and the correct discovery start directory.

title: Mock patched in wrong namespace
example_error: Mock has no effect on imported function under test
explanation: The tested module retains its own function binding.
likely_cause: The original definition was patched instead of the lookup location.
fix: Patch the name in the module where the code actually uses it.

title: Mock signature mismatch
example_error: create_autospec: TypeError: missing a required argument
explanation: The call violates the real callable signature.
likely_cause: The test or implementation supplies incomplete arguments.
fix: Correct the call rather than disabling autospec validation.

title: AsyncMock result not awaited
example_error: RuntimeWarning: coroutine AsyncMockMixin._execute_mock_call was never awaited
explanation: An async mock produces an awaitable.
likely_cause: Synchronous test code calls it like a regular mock.
fix: Await async collaborators and use Mock for synchronous functions.

title: Mock assertion before task completion
example_error: assert_called_once fails while background task is still pending
explanation: The asynchronous work has not reached the call yet.
likely_cause: The test asserts before awaiting completion.
fix: Await a deterministic completion signal instead of adding arbitrary sleeps.

title: Relative test fixture path fails
example_error: Fixture open('fixtures/input.json'): FileNotFoundError
explanation: The fixture path depends on process working directory.
likely_cause: Tests run from another directory.
fix: Resolve fixture paths relative to the test module.

title: Doctest whitespace mismatch
example_error: doctest: Expected output differs only in indentation or spaces
explanation: Doctest compares textual output under its configured rules.
likely_cause: Formatting differs from the documented example.
fix: Fix the expected formatting or intentionally use whitespace normalization.

title: Test leaks environment variable
example_error: Later tests fail after os.environ mutation
explanation: Environment changes survive into subsequent tests.
likely_cause: A test does not restore process state.
fix: Use monkeypatch or a context manager that restores the original environment.

title: Floating point equality assertion
example_error: assert 0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 fails
explanation: Binary floating-point cannot exactly represent many decimal fractions.
likely_cause: The test assumes exact decimal arithmetic.
fix: Use an appropriate tolerance or Decimal for exact decimal requirements.

title: Mutable default leaks between calls
example_error: Repeated function calls unexpectedly reuse earlier list contents
explanation: Default arguments are evaluated once.
likely_cause: A function mutates a default list.
fix: Use None as the default and allocate a new list inside the function.

title: Mean of empty data
example_error: statistics.mean([]): StatisticsError: mean requires at least one data point
explanation: An average needs at least one observation.
likely_cause: Filtering leaves an empty sample.
fix: Check sample size and report missing aggregate data explicitly.

title: Sample variance has one value
example_error: statistics.variance([5]): StatisticsError: variance requires at least two data points
explanation: Sample variance needs two observations.
likely_cause: The group contains only one record.
fix: Handle undersized groups or choose population variance when that model is appropriate.

title: Median of empty data
example_error: statistics.median([]): StatisticsError: no median for empty data
explanation: There is no central observation.
likely_cause: The sample is empty.
fix: Validate nonempty input before calculating the median.

title: Random choice from empty data
example_error: random.choice([]): IndexError: Cannot choose from an empty sequence
explanation: Selection needs at least one candidate.
likely_cause: All candidates were excluded.
fix: Handle the empty candidate set before sampling.

title: Random sample too large
example_error: random.sample([1,2], 3): ValueError: Sample larger than population or is negative
explanation: Sampling without replacement cannot exceed population size.
likely_cause: The requested sample count is invalid.
fix: Validate 0 <= k <= population size or explicitly choose replacement sampling.

title: Random weighted choices total zero
example_error: random.choices(values, weights=[0,0]): ValueError: Total of weights must be greater than zero
explanation: The distribution has no positive total weight.
likely_cause: Every candidate has zero weight.
fix: Validate weights and define a fallback only if it has meaningful semantics.

title: Random weight length mismatch
example_error: random.choices(values, weights=[1]): ValueError: The number of weights does not match the population
explanation: Each candidate needs a corresponding weight.
likely_cause: Filtering changed candidates without changing weights.
fix: Filter paired value-weight records together.

title: Empty random range
example_error: random.randrange(0): ValueError: empty range for randrange()
explanation: The specified interval contains no integer.
likely_cause: A bound is zero or the step direction is wrong.
fix: Validate start, stop, and step before sampling.

title: Negative sleep interval
example_error: time.sleep(-1): ValueError: sleep length must be non-negative
explanation: A delay cannot be negative.
likely_cause: Deadline subtraction produced an elapsed interval.
fix: Clamp an already-expired wait to zero and handle deadline expiry explicitly.

title: Iterator sorted in place incorrectly
example_error: values = values.sort(); later len(values): TypeError: object of type 'NoneType' has no len()
explanation: list.sort mutates the list and returns None.
likely_cause: The return value replaced the original list.
fix: Call values.sort() without assignment or use sorted(values).

title: URL parsing invalid port
example_error: urlparse('http://host:abc').port: ValueError: Port could not be cast to integer value
explanation: The URL's port is not numeric.
likely_cause: A malformed endpoint configuration was supplied.
fix: Validate the URL and use a numeric port in the allowed range.

title: URL unmatched IPv6 bracket
example_error: urlsplit('http://[::1'): ValueError: Invalid IPv6 URL
explanation: A bracketed IPv6 host is incomplete.
likely_cause: The closing bracket is missing.
fix: Use a properly bracketed IPv6 literal in the URL.

title: UUID string malformed
example_error: UUID('not-a-uuid'): ValueError: badly formed hexadecimal UUID string
explanation: The identifier is not a valid UUID representation.
likely_cause: A free-form identifier was supplied.
fix: Validate UUID input and retain plain strings for other identifier schemes.

title: Invalid Base16 digit
example_error: int('GG', 16): ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 16
explanation: The characters are not hexadecimal digits.
likely_cause: The input contains nonhexadecimal text.
fix: Validate the digit alphabet and handle malformed values explicitly.

title: Config section missing
example_error: configparser.NoSectionError: No section: 'database'
explanation: The configuration lacks the requested section.
likely_cause: The wrong file was loaded or its section header is absent.
fix: Confirm loaded filenames and required section names before reading options.

title: Config option missing
example_error: configparser.NoOptionError: No option 'host' in section: 'database'
explanation: A required option is absent.
likely_cause: The section does not define host and no default exists.
fix: Provide the setting or an intentional fallback.

title: Config duplicate section
example_error: configparser.DuplicateSectionError: section 'database' already exists
explanation: Strict parsing rejects duplicate section headers.
likely_cause: Configuration fragments repeat the same section.
fix: Merge settings into one section or use deliberate multi-file overrides.

title: Config interpolation key missing
example_error: configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError
explanation: A substituted configuration variable cannot be resolved.
likely_cause: A percent-style reference names an absent option.
fix: Define the referenced option or disable interpolation for literal percent-containing values.

title: XML malformed document
example_error: xml.etree.ElementTree.ParseError: mismatched tag
explanation: XML tags are not correctly nested or closed.
likely_cause: The document was truncated or assembled incorrectly.
fix: Validate the XML source and use an XML writer for generated content.

title: Weak reference unsupported
example_error: weakref.ref([]): TypeError: cannot create weak reference to 'list' object
explanation: This object type does not support weak references.
likely_cause: A builtin list was used as a weak-reference target.
fix: Use an appropriate weak-reference-capable wrapper with a deliberate lifecycle.

title: Nullable mask converted to NumPy object
example_error: pandas NumPy indexing rejects an object array of nullable booleans
explanation: NumPy needs a concrete boolean mask.
likely_cause: An extension boolean Series was converted without a missing policy.
fix: Resolve missing decisions and convert with to_numpy(dtype=bool, na_value=False) only when exclusion is intended.

title: Boolean filter built before index reset
example_error: pandas mask selects wrong rows after reset_index
explanation: Labels now refer to different records.
likely_cause: A previously computed mask was reused after relabeling.
fix: Compute the mask after the index change or carry a stable record key through the operation.

title: Label slice on unsorted index
example_error: pandas .loc date range returns unexpected rows on unsorted index
explanation: Label slicing depends on index structure.
likely_cause: The index was never sorted after concatenation.
fix: Inspect index monotonicity and sort_index before label range slicing.

title: Negative label mistaken for position
example_error: pandas df.loc[-1]: KeyError: -1
explanation: loc looks for a label named minus one.
likely_cause: Positional indexing was intended.
fix: Use iloc[-1] to select the last row and loc for actual labels.

title: Tuple interpreted as one column key
example_error: pandas df['x', 'y']: KeyError: ('x', 'y')
explanation: A tuple is a single key for a flat column index.
likely_cause: Multiple-column selection used a tuple.
fix: Select df[['x', 'y']] for two flat columns; inspect MultiIndex columns separately.

title: Assigning list to one scalar cell
example_error: pandas .loc scalar assignment: Must have equal len keys and value when setting with an iterable
explanation: Assignment is trying to distribute an iterable.
likely_cause: A list is intended as one object value.
fix: Use an object dtype column and scalar .at assignment, or normalize the list into separate rows.

title: Repeated row label returns several rows
example_error: pandas .loc customer returns DataFrame instead of Series
explanation: The label is not unique.
likely_cause: Several records share the index key.
fix: Check index.is_unique; keep duplicates intentionally or create a unique composite key before scalar lookup.

title: Inclusive label range surprise
example_error: pandas .loc['a':'c'] includes row c
explanation: Label slices include the stop label.
likely_cause: Code expected Python positional slice semantics.
fix: Use iloc for half-open positional ranges or express an explicit label predicate.

title: Callable indexer returns wrong object
example_error: pandas callable .loc indexer returns a DataFrame and selection fails
explanation: An indexer callable must return a valid index selector.
likely_cause: The lambda returned filtered data instead of a mask.
fix: Return a boolean Series, labels, or a slice from the callable.

title: At lookup creates unintended row
example_error: pandas .at assignment unexpectedly adds a new row
explanation: Label assignment can enlarge a frame.
likely_cause: A misspelled row label was assigned.
fix: Validate the label exists before assigning and use positional iat when position is intended.

title: DataFrame constructor receives zero dimensional array
example_error: pandas DataFrame scalar numpy array: Must pass 2-d input
