explanation: A zero-dimensional array does not define rows and columns.
likely_cause: A scalar NumPy result was passed to the table constructor.
fix: Wrap the value in a deliberate one-row structure with named columns.

title: DataFrame constructor receives three dimensional array
example_error: pandas DataFrame ndarray ndim 3: Must pass 2-d input
explanation: A frame has two table axes.
likely_cause: A batch of matrices was passed directly.
fix: Choose an explicit flattening or per-batch representation and retain dimension labels.

title: Data width disagrees with columns
example_error: pandas constructor: columns passed, passed data had a different number of columns
explanation: The labels and row widths disagree.
likely_cause: The columns list has the wrong length.
fix: Inspect each row width and provide one column name per value.

title: Series alignment inserts missing values
example_error: pandas DataFrame from Series unexpectedly contains NaN
explanation: Indexed Series align on labels during construction.
likely_cause: Inputs use different indexes.
fix: Align the intended keys first or use arrays if row position alone defines correspondence.

title: Dictionary orientation reversed
example_error: pandas DataFrame.from_dict puts record identifiers in columns
explanation: The default orientation treats outer keys as columns.
likely_cause: The input maps row identifiers to records.
fix: Use orient='index' and name the resulting index appropriately.

title: Generator consumed before construction
example_error: pandas DataFrame from generator is empty after preview
explanation: Iterators are consumed once.
likely_cause: Debugging already exhausted the generator.
fix: Materialize once when appropriate or recreate the iterator before constructing the frame.

title: Structured record field names lost
example_error: pandas DataFrame from tuples has integer column names
explanation: Plain tuples do not carry field labels.
likely_cause: A named schema was omitted.
fix: Pass explicit columns or use from_records with structured records.

title: Nested JSON stays nested
example_error: pandas DataFrame JSON field still contains dictionaries
explanation: The constructor does not recursively flatten records.
likely_cause: Nested objects were passed directly.
fix: Use json_normalize with explicit record_path and meta when required.

title: Ragged nested lists gain NaN
example_error: pandas constructor fills short rows with NaN
explanation: Missing positions are padded during rectangular construction.
likely_cause: Input rows have inconsistent schemas.
fix: Validate row shapes and repair source records instead of assuming padding is valid data.

title: Copy construction still shares objects
example_error: pandas deep copy changing a nested list changes original
explanation: Deep frame copying does not recursively clone Python objects.
likely_cause: An object column contains mutable lists.
fix: Avoid mutable objects in cells or explicitly deep-copy nested values before mutation.

title: CSV delimiter creates one column
example_error: pandas read_csv imports the entire line into one column
explanation: The selected separator does not match the file.
likely_cause: A semicolon or tab file used the comma default.
fix: Inspect raw lines and pass the correct sep.

title: CSV header consumed as data
example_error: pandas read_csv column names appear in the first record
explanation: The parser was told there is no header.
likely_cause: header=None was used on a headered file.
fix: Use the correct header row and reserve names for intentional replacement labels.

title: CSV data consumed as header
example_error: pandas read_csv loses the first data record
explanation: The first row was interpreted as column names.
likely_cause: A headerless file used default header inference.
fix: Pass header=None and supply the expected column names.

title: CSV leading zeros disappear
example_error: pandas read_csv postal code 00123 becomes 123
explanation: Numeric inference discarded formatting.
likely_cause: Identifiers were read as integers.
fix: Read identifier columns with dtype='string' so leading zeros survive ingestion.

title: CSV NA identifier disappears
example_error: pandas read_csv country code NA becomes missing
explanation: Default missing-value tokens include NA.
likely_cause: A literal identifier overlaps a missing marker.
fix: Use keep_default_na=False and specify the actual missing tokens for that column.

title: CSV decimal comma read as text
example_error: pandas read_csv prices like 12,50 have object dtype
explanation: The decimal convention was not configured.
likely_cause: A locale-specific decimal separator appears in numeric fields.
fix: Set decimal=',' with the correct field separator and validate parsed values.

title: CSV thousands separator blocks numeric parsing
example_error: pandas read_csv amount 1,234 remains a string
explanation: Formatting separators were retained.
likely_cause: Quoted thousands separators were not declared.
fix: Pass thousands=',' when that convention is consistent and inspect the resulting dtype.

title: CSV mixed types across chunks
example_error: pandas DtypeWarning: Columns have mixed types
explanation: Chunk inference found incompatible values.
likely_cause: A column mixes numeric data and text tokens.
fix: Set an intentional dtype, inspect invalid tokens, and convert with a documented missing-value policy.

title: CSV malformed quoted field
example_error: pandas read_csv: EOF inside string starting at row
explanation: A quoted field was never closed.
likely_cause: The export is truncated or uses a different quote convention.
fix: Inspect the source row and fix quoting or pass the matching quotechar and escapechar.

title: CSV usecols names not found
example_error: pandas read_csv: Usecols do not match columns
explanation: Requested columns are absent from parsed headers.
likely_cause: A wrong delimiter, whitespace, or naming mismatch changed headers.
fix: Inspect a header-only read and correct sep or exact usecols names.

title: Excel formulas return missing cached result
example_error: pandas read_excel formula cell is NaN although Excel shows formula
explanation: Readers may use cached formula results and do not calculate formulas.
likely_cause: The workbook has never been recalculated by a spreadsheet engine.
fix: Recalculate and save the source workbook or compute the required values explicitly.

title: Excel worksheet name absent
example_error: pandas read_excel: Worksheet named Summary not found
explanation: The workbook has no sheet with that exact name.
likely_cause: The export renamed a tab or includes extra spaces.
fix: Inspect ExcelFile.sheet_names and select the actual sheet.

title: Excel header offset imports report title as columns
example_error: pandas read_excel columns are report title and Unnamed labels
explanation: The actual table starts below introductory rows.
likely_cause: The default header row points to a report banner.
fix: Set header or skiprows based on the actual worksheet table layout.

title: Excel merged cells produce gaps
example_error: pandas read_excel merged headings contain NaN
explanation: Merged cells usually store a value only in their anchor cell.
likely_cause: The sheet uses presentation layout instead of a rectangular table.
fix: Read the appropriate header rows and fill only the intended heading region.

title: Parquet dataset partition type conflict
example_error: pandas read_parquet dataset cannot merge incompatible partition field types
explanation: Dataset fragments must agree on schema.
likely_cause: Files or directory partitions encode the same field differently.
fix: Normalize the dataset schema and rebuild inconsistent partitions.

title: Parquet mixed object conversion fails
example_error: pandas parquet write: Could not convert text with type str tried to convert to int64
explanation: A column cannot be represented with one Arrow type.
likely_cause: An object column mixes numbers and text.
fix: Choose a consistent schema and clean or cast the column before writing.

title: JSON lines parsed as one document
example_error: pandas read_json: Trailing data

title: Frame equality fails on row order

title: Manylinux wheel on musl Linux
example_error: pip manylinux wheel not accepted in Alpine environment
explanation: The binary targets a different C library ecosystem.
likely_cause: A glibc wheel was supplied to a musl environment.
fix: Use a compatible musllinux wheel or a supported glibc-based image.

title: Mac wheel minimum system version too new
example_error: pip macOS wheel unavailable for older deployment target
explanation: The wheel requires a newer operating system baseline.
likely_cause: The host is older than supported tags.
fix: Use a supported older release or upgrade the deployment OS.

title: Wheel distribution version differs from metadata
example_error: pip inconsistent version expected one version metadata has another
explanation: Filename and embedded metadata must describe the same release.
likely_cause: The wheel was packaged with mismatched version inputs.
fix: Rebuild from consistent version metadata and verify the release artifact.

title: Wheel archive corrupted
example_error: pip wheel installation: BadZipFile File is not a zip file
explanation: A wheel must be a valid ZIP-format archive.
likely_cause: The download is incomplete or contains an error page.
fix: Redownload from the trusted source and verify the artifact hash.

title: Wheel metadata directory inconsistent
example_error: pip invalid wheel .dist-info directory does not match distribution
explanation: The archive metadata layout is invalid.
likely_cause: The wheel was assembled or repackaged incorrectly.
fix: Rebuild with a supported build backend rather than editing the archive manually.

title: Wheel built for unsupported ABI
example_error: pip abi tag incompatible with target interpreter
explanation: The extension ABI differs from the running interpreter.
likely_cause: The build used an incompatible Python configuration.
fix: Build or obtain a wheel for the target ABI and verify supported tags with pip debug.

title: Pure Python wheel installs but native dependency fails
example_error: pip py3-none-any package installs then native dependency import fails
explanation: The wrapper wheel does not guarantee its dependencies are portable.
likely_cause: A transitive native package lacks target compatibility.
fix: Check the entire dependency chain and use supported builds for the target platform.

title: Wheel absent for new interpreter release
example_error: pip downloads sdist on newly released Python
explanation: Publishers may not yet provide wheels for the new runtime.
likely_cause: No compatible binary candidate exists.
fix: Use a supported interpreter with published wheels or install documented build prerequisites.

title: Backend path escapes source tree
example_error: pip build backend-path points outside source tree
explanation: In-tree backend paths must remain within the source project.
likely_cause: A relative path traverses outside the build root.
fix: Package the backend inside the source tree and correct backend-path.

title: Build dependency resolver uses incompatible backend release
example_error: pip isolated build breaks after backend dependency update
explanation: Unbounded build requirements can select new tooling.
likely_cause: A backend release changes behavior relied on by the project.
fix: Declare justified compatible build requirements and test source builds in isolation.

title: No build isolation missing build tool
example_error: pip --no-build-isolation: No module named setuptools
explanation: Disabling isolation makes the current environment responsible for build tools.
likely_cause: Required backend dependencies were not installed.
fix: Install the declared build requirements or restore build isolation.

title: C++ standard unsupported by compiler
example_error: pip compilation unrecognized command line option std=c++20
explanation: The selected compiler does not support the required language level.
likely_cause: The native dependency requires a newer toolchain.
fix: Use the package's documented supported compiler version or a compatible prebuilt wheel.

title: Compiler architecture does not match interpreter
example_error: pip linker machine type x64 conflicts with target ARM64
explanation: Extension objects and interpreter architecture must agree.
likely_cause: The build uses the wrong compiler target.
fix: Select a toolchain matching the target interpreter or use a compatible wheel.

title: System library headers missing
example_error: pip compilation: fatal error ffi.h No such file or directory
explanation: A native dependency needs external development headers.
likely_cause: The required system development package is absent.
fix: Install the documented system library headers for the target distribution.

title: Rust minimum version not satisfied
example_error: pip cargo build rustc version is not supported by package
explanation: The Rust compiler is older than the project's minimum.
likely_cause: An installed toolchain exists but is too old.
fix: Use the documented minimum supported Rust toolchain or a compatible wheel.

title: CMake executable unavailable
example_error: pip build: CMake must be installed to build extensions
explanation: The backend delegates native configuration to CMake.
likely_cause: The build environment lacks CMake.
fix: Install the required CMake version and native prerequisites or select a compatible wheel.

title: Native library version too old for extension
example_error: pip configure found library but required version is newer
explanation: Discovery succeeded but compatibility checks failed.
likely_cause: The system development library is outdated.
fix: Install a supported library version and rebuild against matching headers and runtime files.

title: Compiler killed during build
example_error: pip wheel build: compiler terminated by Killed signal
explanation: The build process was terminated, often due to resource limits.
likely_cause: Parallel compilation may exceed memory.
fix: Check resource logs and reduce build parallelism or build on a larger supported machine.

title: Pyproject TOML syntax invalid
example_error: pip pyproject.toml: TOMLDecodeError
explanation: The project metadata file cannot be parsed.
likely_cause: A malformed string, table, or duplicate key is present.
fix: Fix the reported TOML location and validate the file before rebuilding.

title: Build system requires is not a list
example_error: pip pyproject.toml build-system.requires invalid configuration
explanation: Build requirements must follow the expected schema.
likely_cause: The field uses a string or invalid structure.
fix: Provide a list of valid dependency requirement strings.

title: Project version invalid
example_error: pip metadata: InvalidVersion for project release
explanation: The version does not follow supported packaging syntax.
likely_cause: A custom label was used as the package version.
fix: Use a valid PEP 440 version and keep arbitrary build labels in appropriate metadata.

title: Dynamic version file absent in source archive
example_error: pip preparing metadata fails reading version file
explanation: The version resolver depends on a file missing from the source distribution.
likely_cause: Packaging rules excluded required metadata inputs.
fix: Include the required file and test building from the produced source archive.

title: Readme path missing during metadata build
example_error: pip metadata generation: README file does not exist
explanation: Declared project metadata references an absent file.
likely_cause: The source archive omitted the README.
fix: Include the referenced file or correct the metadata path.

title: License file omitted from package archive
example_error: pip build metadata references missing license file
explanation: The configured license resource is unavailable.
likely_cause: The release packaging rules excluded it.
fix: Include the correct license file and rebuild the distribution.

title: Extras name not provided by project
example_error: pip warning package does not provide the extra requested
explanation: The requested optional dependency group is undefined.
likely_cause: The extra name is misspelled or belongs to another version.
fix: Check supported extras for the selected release and use the documented name.

title: Dependency marker skips package on current OS
example_error: pip ignoring requirement markers do not match your environment
explanation: Conditional requirements intentionally exclude this environment.
likely_cause: The marker specifies another platform or Python version.
fix: Review the marker and change it only if the dependency is actually supported here.

title: Package discovery finds multiple top-level modules
example_error: pip build: Multiple top-level packages discovered in a flat-layout
explanation: Automatic discovery cannot determine intended distribution contents.
likely_cause: Several directories look like installable packages.
fix: Configure explicit discovery or use a src layout with the intended packages.

title: Source package contains no import module
example_error: pip install project succeeds but intended module missing from wheel
explanation: Distribution metadata can exist without the expected package files.
likely_cause: Package discovery or include rules exclude source code.
fix: Inspect wheel contents and fix build configuration before republishing.

title: Git dependency requires large file assets
example_error: pip VCS build reads Git LFS pointer instead of binary asset
explanation: The checkout contains a pointer rather than the expected asset.
likely_cause: Large-file content was not fetched.
fix: Follow the repository's documented Git LFS setup and verify required assets before building.

title: Git repository URL selects wrong project
example_error: pip VCS metadata package name disagrees with requirement
explanation: The repository builds a different distribution.
likely_cause: The URL or declared direct-reference name is wrong.
fix: Confirm the intended repository and use its actual distribution name.

title: Private Git authentication fails
example_error: pip git clone: Authentication failed
explanation: The repository requires authorized credentials.
likely_cause: The environment lacks a supported Git credential configuration.
fix: Configure approved Git authentication without committing tokens to requirements.

title: Git SSH host verification fails
example_error: pip git clone: Host key verification failed
explanation: SSH cannot establish trusted host identity.
likely_cause: The host key is unknown or changed.
fix: Verify the server fingerprint through a trusted channel and update known hosts appropriately.

title: VCS subdirectory points outside package
example_error: pip git subdirectory: neither setup.py nor pyproject.toml found
explanation: The selected directory is not a buildable Python project.
likely_cause: The subdirectory fragment is incorrect.
fix: Point the requirement at the directory containing the project's build metadata.

title: VCS submodule dependency missing
example_error: pip VCS build fails because submodule source is absent
explanation: The project build needs additional checked-out source.
likely_cause: Repository or archive preparation omitted a submodule.
fix: Use the project's documented recursive checkout and packaging process.

title: Editable package excludes new namespace subpackage
example_error: pip editable import new namespace package fails after adding folder
explanation: Editable discovery mappings may need rebuilding.
likely_cause: A new package was added after installation.
fix: Verify namespace discovery configuration and reinstall the editable project.

title: Editable source deleted after install
example_error: pip editable package import fails after deleting checkout
explanation: Editable installation points to source files.
likely_cause: The referenced checkout was removed.
fix: Restore the checkout or install a built noneditable distribution.

title: Editable metadata changes not reflected
example_error: pip editable install ignores newly added dependency
explanation: Editable source changes do not automatically reinstall metadata.
likely_cause: Dependency declarations changed after installation.
fix: Reinstall the editable project to refresh metadata and dependencies.

title: VCS unpinned branch changes installation
example_error: pip same requirements installs different code from branch
explanation: A branch is a moving reference.
likely_cause: The dependency was not pinned to a commit.
fix: Use an immutable reviewed commit or a versioned release artifact.

title: Installation disk is full
example_error: pip install: No space left on device
explanation: The target or temporary filesystem is exhausted.
likely_cause: Large wheels and extraction buffers exceed free space.
fix: Check both installation and temporary volumes and free space safely before retrying.

title: Temporary directory not writable
example_error: pip tempfile: No usable temporary directory found
explanation: Build and extraction need a writable temp location.
likely_cause: Permissions or environment paths are invalid.
fix: Configure an existing writable temporary directory within the approved workspace.

title: Windows file locked during upgrade
example_error: pip WinError 32 file is being used by another process
explanation: Windows prevents replacing an open file.
likely_cause: A running interpreter or service has loaded the package.
fix: Stop the relevant process and rerun the upgrade in the intended environment.

title: Source archive contains Windows reserved filename
example_error: pip extraction fails on a reserved Windows device name
explanation: Some filenames are invalid on Windows.
likely_cause: The distribution includes a platform-incompatible path.
fix: Use a corrected upstream release or build on a supported target with portable filenames.

title: Read only container filesystem
example_error: pip install: Read-only file system in site-packages
explanation: The runtime filesystem cannot be modified.
likely_cause: Dependencies are installed after the image becomes immutable.
fix: Install dependencies during image build or use an approved writable environment.

title: Wheel cache permission denied
example_error: pip cache directory permission denied
explanation: The current identity cannot access cached files.
likely_cause: A previous run used a different privileged account.
fix: Use a user-owned cache directory and correct ownership through approved administration.

title: Broken symlink in target environment
example_error: pip install fails resolving site-packages symlink
explanation: The target path references a nonexistent location.
likely_cause: The environment was partially moved or its mount disappeared.
fix: Restore the required mount or recreate the environment.

title: Antivirus quarantines extension during install
example_error: pip install succeeds but extension file disappears on Windows
explanation: Security software may remove a file after extraction.
likely_cause: A security event affected the installed artifact.
fix: Check security logs and validate the package source with the administrator before restoring anything.

title: User scripts directory not on PATH
example_error: pip warning scripts are installed in directory which is not on PATH
explanation: The command launcher exists but the shell cannot find it.
likely_cause: The user scripts directory is not searched.
fix: Use python -m for supported modules or add the correct user scripts directory to PATH.

title: Target directory already contains package
example_error: pip --target warning target directory already exists
explanation: The destination contains files from an earlier installation.
likely_cause: Repeated target installs reuse a populated directory.
fix: Build a fresh deployment directory to avoid mixed package contents.

title: Hash locked requirement lacks hashes
example_error: pip --require-hashes: Hashes are required in --require-hashes mode
explanation: Every resolved artifact needs an approved hash.
likely_cause: Some requirements were not fully hash-locked.
fix: Generate a complete reviewed lock with hashes for all required artifacts.

title: Hash mode requirement not pinned
example_error: pip --require-hashes: requirements must have their versions pinned
explanation: A mutable version range cannot identify one reviewed release.
likely_cause: The requirement uses an open range.
fix: Pin the intended exact version and record trusted artifact hashes.

title: Hash list mixes algorithm with digest incorrectly
example_error: pip invalid hash option malformed sha256 digest
explanation: Hash declarations require the expected algorithm and hexadecimal digest syntax.
likely_cause: The manifest contains a copied filename or incomplete digest.
fix: Compute the trusted artifact digest and record it in the documented --hash format.

title: Different platform wheel missing from hash list
example_error: pip hash mismatch only on another operating system
explanation: Different wheels have different hashes.
likely_cause: The lock records only one platform's artifact.
fix: Include reviewed hashes for every supported platform artifact or maintain platform-specific locks.

title: Cache contains damaged download
example_error: pip cached wheel repeatedly fails extraction
explanation: The cached artifact is invalid.
likely_cause: An interrupted or damaged download was reused.
fix: Remove the specific bad cache item and redownload from the trusted source.

title: Direct URL archive hash fragment wrong
example_error: pip direct URL expected sha256 differs from download
explanation: The URL's integrity assertion does not match the bytes.
likely_cause: The URL points to another build or the hash is stale.
fix: Verify the intended immutable artifact and correct the reference only after review.

title: Untrusted HTTP repository ignored
example_error: pip repository is not a trusted or secure host and is being ignored
explanation: The configured source lacks secure transport.
likely_cause: The index uses plain HTTP.
fix: Use the repository's HTTPS endpoint with valid certificate verification.

title: Local wheel changed after review
example_error: pip local wheel hash differs from release manifest
explanation: The local artifact is not the reviewed build.
likely_cause: It was rebuilt or modified under the same filename.
fix: Use the verified release artifact and distinguish rebuilds with appropriate versioning.

title: Requirements URL includes exposed credential
example_error: pip logs or requirements contain repository token
explanation: Credentials embedded in URLs can leak through files and logs.
likely_cause: Authentication was stored in the dependency specification.
fix: Remove the secret, rotate it if exposed, and use approved credential storage.

title: Frozen environment is not a portable lock
example_error: pip freeze output fails to reproduce on another platform
explanation: Freeze records installed distributions without all target compatibility decisions.
likely_cause: Platform-specific packages or local paths are included.
fix: Create and test an explicit dependency lock for each supported target.

title: Pip check passes but binary import still fails
example_error: pip check reports no broken requirements while extension cannot load
explanation: Metadata compatibility does not test native loading.
likely_cause: Runtime libraries or ABI compatibility are broken.
fix: Run import and application smoke tests in addition to pip check.

title: Uninstall command chooses shared environment unexpectedly
example_error: pip uninstall removes package used by another project
explanation: The command targets the active interpreter's environment.
likely_cause: Several projects share one environment accidentally.
fix: Confirm the interpreter before removal and isolate project dependency environments.

title: Uninstall leaves user-created package files
example_error: pip uninstall leaves modified or extra files in package directory
explanation: Pip removes recorded installed files, not arbitrary user data.
likely_cause: Additional files were created after installation.
fix: Review leftovers and migrate user data before any intentional cleanup.

title: Package metadata claims version different from imported module
example_error: pip show version differs from module.__version__
explanation: Metadata and imported code may come from different locations.
likely_cause: Multiple installations or stale paths are present.
fix: Inspect both distribution location and module file path, then recreate a consistent environment.

title: Upgrade pip command targets wrong Python
example_error: pip self upgrade reports success but pip --version unchanged
explanation: The upgraded module differs from the invoked launcher.
likely_cause: Multiple pip executables are on PATH.
fix: Use the intended python -m pip consistently and inspect its version path.

title: Package import name differs from distribution
example_error: pip show finds distribution but import same name fails
explanation: Distribution names and import names can differ.
likely_cause: The install name was assumed to be the module name.
fix: Use the import documented by the package, such as sklearn for scikit-learn.

title: Local module shadows installed distribution
example_error: pip package installed but import resolves to project file
explanation: Python searches the local project path before site packages.
likely_cause: A file has the same name as the dependency.
fix: Rename the conflicting module and remove only its stale generated cache if needed.

title: Upgrade strategy keeps already satisfied dependency
example_error: pip upgrade top-level package leaves dependency at older compatible version
explanation: The default dependency upgrade strategy may retain satisfied versions.
likely_cause: The user expects every dependency to move to newest.
fix: Choose an intentional upgrade strategy and verify the resulting full dependency set.

title: Old environment retains removed requirements
example_error: pip install -r does not remove packages deleted from file
explanation: Installing requirements is not a full environment synchronization.
likely_cause: Previously installed packages remain present.
fix: Recreate the environment from the current lock or use a controlled synchronization workflow.

title: Pip inspect output mistaken for requirements
example_error: pip -r inspect.json: Invalid requirement
explanation: The inspection report is structured metadata, not install specifications.
likely_cause: A diagnostic JSON report was used as a requirements file.
fix: Use a valid requirements or lock format and retain inspect output for auditing.

title: Docker dependencies installed in discarded stage
example_error: pip install succeeds in builder but final image cannot import
explanation: Multi-stage images do not automatically retain installed files.
likely_cause: The final stage lacks the installed environment.
fix: Install in the runtime image or copy a compatible complete environment with its required libraries.

title: Docker build cache hides dependency change
example_error: pip layer not rebuilt after requirements update
explanation: The build context or COPY path does not include the changed file.
likely_cause: The image uses a different requirements file.
fix: Verify context paths and image digest, then rebuild the actual dependency layer.

title: Serverless runtime uses different Python
example_error: pip local wheel works but deployed function cannot load it
explanation: The deployment runtime differs from the build target.
likely_cause: Wheels were built locally for another interpreter or OS.
fix: Build dependencies for the documented serverless runtime and architecture.

title: Requirements omitted from deployment bundle
example_error: pip deployment installs no project dependencies
explanation: The platform cannot discover the dependency manifest.
likely_cause: The build root points to another folder.
fix: Place the manifest at the configured build root and inspect build logs.

title: Build-time credentials absent in container
example_error: pip private dependency fails only during Docker build
explanation: Host authentication is not automatically available inside the build.
likely_cause: The build lacks repository credentials.
fix: Use the platform's supported secret injection without baking credentials into image layers.

title: Runtime shared library absent after wheel install
example_error: pip binary package import: shared object file cannot open
explanation: A wheel may rely on external runtime libraries.
likely_cause: The image lacks a required system library.
fix: Install documented runtime libraries in the final image and verify import there.

title: Offline wheelhouse misses transitive dependency
example_error: pip offline install: No matching distribution found for transitive dependency
explanation: Every required distribution must be available locally.
likely_cause: Only top-level packages were downloaded.
fix: Resolve and collect the full target-compatible dependency closure before deployment.

title: Editable path points to developer workstation
example_error: pip deployed editable dependency references C drive checkout
explanation: Editable metadata is machine-specific.
likely_cause: A development environment was copied into deployment.
fix: Build a regular wheel and install it into the deployment environment.

title: CI dependency cache shared across incompatible targets
example_error: pip CI restored cache contains wrong platform binaries
explanation: Cache keys must distinguish runtime compatibility.
likely_cause: Different OS or Python jobs reuse installed environments.
fix: Key caches by platform, architecture, interpreter, and dependency lock; cache downloads rather than whole environments when appropriate.

title: Deployment package exceeds size limit
example_error: pip bundled dependencies exceed function artifact limit
explanation: The platform limits deployment size.
likely_cause: Large optional packages were included unnecessarily.
fix: Remove unused dependencies and use a supported container or deployment format when the required set is inherently large.

title: Static route captured by dynamic route
example_error: FastAPI GET /users/me returns integer validation error for user_id
explanation: Routes are evaluated in declaration order.
likely_cause: A dynamic users path was registered before the static me path.
fix: Declare the specific static route before the overlapping parameter route.

title: Redirect Location leaks internal host
example_error: FastAPI 307 Location points to container hostname
explanation: Redirect URLs depend on perceived public host and scheme.
likely_cause: Proxy forwarding is incomplete or untrusted.
fix: Configure trusted forwarding and verify Location uses the public origin.

title: Router defined but never included
example_error: FastAPI endpoint exists in source but returns 404 and is absent from docs
explanation: Defining a router does not attach it to the application.
likely_cause: include_router was omitted or applied to another app.
fix: Include the router on the app object actually served.

title: Router prefix duplicated
example_error: FastAPI expected /api/items but docs show /api/api/items
explanation: Prefixes accumulate during router inclusion.
likely_cause: The route and parent router both include the same prefix.
fix: Define each path segment at one intentional level.

title: Router prefix ends with slash
example_error: FastAPI include_router assertion prefix must not end with slash
explanation: Router prefixes and route paths have separate slash conventions.
likely_cause: The configured prefix has a trailing slash.
fix: Remove the trailing slash from the prefix and keep route paths explicit.

title: Path operation missing leading slash
example_error: FastAPI route registration assertion routed paths must start with slash
explanation: A route path must use the expected absolute path form.
likely_cause: The decorator contains items instead of /items.
fix: Add the leading slash to the path declaration.

title: Duplicate method and path uses first handler
example_error: FastAPI changing second GET /items handler has no effect
explanation: Overlapping registrations make route behavior ambiguous.
likely_cause: Two handlers share the same method and path.
fix: Keep one intended registration and check generated routes in tests.

title: Path converter rejects slash-containing value
example_error: FastAPI file path parameter returns 404 for nested folders
explanation: The default parameter matches one path segment.
likely_cause: The value contains slashes.
fix: Use a path converter only when multi-segment values are intended, and validate filesystem access separately.

title: Mount prefix missing from client request
example_error: FastAPI mounted subapplication endpoint returns 404 at root
explanation: Mounted apps live under their mount path.
likely_cause: The client omits the prefix.
fix: Use the full mounted URL and verify the subapplication's generated docs.

title: HEAD request unsupported by declared GET operation
example_error: FastAPI health monitor HEAD request receives 405
explanation: A GET route need not automatically provide the expected HEAD behavior.
likely_cause: The monitor probes using HEAD.
fix: Configure the monitor to use GET or explicitly implement the required HEAD contract.

title: Query list parsed as one comma string
example_error: FastAPI list query receives tags=a,b as one value
explanation: Repeated parameters and comma-separated strings have different schemas.
likely_cause: The client assumed automatic comma splitting.
fix: Send repeated tags parameters or explicitly implement a documented comma parser.

title: List parameter unexpectedly treated as body
example_error: FastAPI GET list filter yields 422 loc body
explanation: A complex parameter may be interpreted as body data.
likely_cause: A list annotation lacks an explicit Query declaration.
fix: Declare Query for the list and test the documented request encoding.

title: Query alias uses wrong public name
example_error: FastAPI 422 loc query item-id while client sends item_id
explanation: Aliases define the external parameter name.
likely_cause: The client uses the Python identifier instead of the alias.
fix: Send the documented alias or revise the declared public schema.

title: Required query has empty string
example_error: FastAPI query q= passes presence check but fails min_length
explanation: Presence and content validity are different constraints.
likely_cause: The parameter exists with an empty value.
fix: Send a nonempty value or adjust constraints if empty text is meaningful.

title: UUID version constraint rejects otherwise valid UUID
example_error: FastAPI 422 uuid_version expected version 4
explanation: The field requires a specific UUID variant.
likely_cause: A valid UUID of another version was supplied.
fix: Use the specified UUID version or loosen the schema only if all versions are valid domain identifiers.

title: Literal query discriminator rejects obsolete client value
example_error: FastAPI 422 literal_error for api_mode=legacy
explanation: The field accepts only declared literal values.
likely_cause: An older client uses a retired mode.
fix: Update the client contract or provide an explicit compatible transition path.

title: Boolean query token unrecognized
example_error: FastAPI 422 bool_parsing for enabled=maybe
explanation: The value is not an accepted boolean representation.
likely_cause: A free-text state was sent to a boolean field.
fix: Use documented boolean values or model a multi-state enum.

title: Decimal query exceeds allowed precision
example_error: FastAPI 422 decimal_max_digits for monetary amount
explanation: The decimal field limits precision.
likely_cause: The supplied amount has too many digits.
fix: Send an amount within the documented precision and use a deliberate rounding policy.

title: Optional query still required
example_error: FastAPI nullable query returns Field required when omitted
explanation: Allowing None does not necessarily provide a default.
likely_cause: The declaration has a nullable type but no omission default.
fix: Set a default of None when omission is intended and inspect the generated required flag.

title: Path value percent decoding changes meaning
example_error: FastAPI path identifier contains unexpected decoded characters
explanation: URL encoding is decoded during routing.
likely_cause: The client treats encoded separators as opaque text.
fix: Use an appropriate query or body field for opaque identifiers and test proxy decoding behavior.

title: Body sent as form instead of JSON object
example_error: FastAPI 422 model_attributes_type when request uses form encoding
explanation: The endpoint expects a structured JSON model.
likely_cause: The client sent form-urlencoded content.
fix: Send JSON with the correct content type or declare a Form-based endpoint.

title: Nested request model receives stringified JSON
example_error: FastAPI 422 body settings model_attributes_type input is JSON text
explanation: The nested field expects an object, not a string containing JSON.
likely_cause: The client serializes the nested object twice.
fix: Serialize the outer request once with the nested object intact.

title: JSON object sent to list model
example_error: FastAPI 422 body list_type
explanation: The endpoint expects a JSON array.
likely_cause: The client supplied one unwrapped object.
fix: Wrap records in an array or change the contract to a single object.

title: Embedded body key omitted
example_error: FastAPI Body embed=True 422 loc body item
explanation: Embedding requires an outer named field.
likely_cause: The client sent the inner model directly.
fix: Wrap the payload under the documented parameter name.

title: Multiple body parameters need named wrapper
example_error: FastAPI two body parameters 422 missing item and user
explanation: Multiple body parameters form a composite object.
likely_cause: The client flattened both models into one object.
fix: Send separate named fields matching the OpenAPI request schema.

title: Scalar body interpreted as query
example_error: FastAPI integer argument 422 loc query priority despite JSON body
explanation: Scalar parameters default to query unless declared otherwise.
likely_cause: The handler lacks an explicit Body declaration.
fix: Use Body for the scalar and document whether it is embedded.

title: JSON body starts with unexpected UTF8 BOM handling
example_error: FastAPI request parser rejects prefixed or incorrectly encoded JSON bytes
explanation: The body encoding does not match the parser's expected JSON representation.
likely_cause: A text export added encoding markers or invalid bytes.
fix: Send UTF-8 JSON through a standard HTTP client serializer and inspect actual bytes.

title: Empty request body for required model
example_error: FastAPI 422 loc body Field required with zero-byte request
explanation: No body was sent.
likely_cause: The client omitted its JSON payload.
fix: Provide the required JSON object and verify the request builder actually sends it.

title: Content type says JSON but body is text
example_error: FastAPI json_invalid after posting plain error message
explanation: The parser follows the declared JSON content type.
likely_cause: Raw text was labeled application/json.
fix: Send a JSON string or object matching the schema, or declare a text body endpoint.

title: GET body omitted by client library
example_error: FastAPI GET endpoint body validation fails only in browser
explanation: GET bodies are poorly supported across clients and intermediaries.
likely_cause: The API relies on a GET request body.
fix: Use query parameters for retrieval filters or a suitable POST contract.

title: Request model drops unexpected fields silently
example_error: FastAPI misspelled payload field ignored and default used
explanation: Permissive extra-field handling can hide typos.
likely_cause: The model leaves extra handling at an ignore policy.
fix: Use extra='forbid' when clients must follow the exact schema and test misspelled keys.

title: Strict request date rejects Python-only representation
example_error: FastAPI strict date field rejects unexpected request representation
explanation: Strictness and input mode affect accepted date values.
likely_cause: The client sends an undocumented date structure.
fix: Use the documented ISO date format and test validation through actual JSON requests.

title: Strict integer rejects boolean
example_error: FastAPI 422 int_type for top_k=true
explanation: Booleans are not accepted as strict integers.
likely_cause: A checkbox value reached a numeric field.
fix: Send an integer within the allowed range.

title: Whitespace text passes minimum length
example_error: FastAPI model accepts a body containing only spaces
explanation: Length constraints count whitespace characters.
likely_cause: Semantic nonblank validation was omitted.
fix: Add a field validator that rejects text whose stripped value is empty.

title: Unicode normalization changes validation length
example_error: FastAPI visually identical input has different character counts
explanation: Combined characters can have different code-point lengths.
likely_cause: Client and server count different representations.
fix: Define and test one normalization and character-count policy for the field.

title: String pattern mismatch
example_error: FastAPI 422 string_pattern_mismatch for identifier
explanation: The string does not satisfy the declared pattern.
likely_cause: The client sends characters outside the identifier format.
fix: Use the documented format and keep client validation aligned with server rules.

title: Union body matches unintended branch
example_error: FastAPI union model coerces payload into unexpected variant
explanation: Overlapping model schemas can be ambiguous.
likely_cause: Variants lack a clear discriminator.
fix: Use a discriminated union with distinct literal type fields.

title: Discriminator field missing
example_error: FastAPI 422 union_tag_not_found
explanation: The validator cannot choose a union variant.
likely_cause: The payload omits its discriminator key.
fix: Include the documented discriminator and matching variant fields.

title: Discriminator value unknown
example_error: FastAPI 422 union_tag_invalid
explanation: The discriminator names no declared variant.
likely_cause: The client uses an unsupported type value.
fix: Send a supported literal tag or extend the schema intentionally.

title: Custom validator raises TypeError
example_error: FastAPI validator TypeError produces server error instead of 422
explanation: Some validator programming errors are not converted to validation errors.
likely_cause: The validator uses an inappropriate exception or invalid operation.
fix: Raise ValueError for intended input rejection and fix actual TypeError bugs.

title: Old validator decorator migration
example_error: FastAPI Pydantic migration validator API deprecated
explanation: Validation APIs differ across major Pydantic versions.
likely_cause: The model still uses an older decorator style.
fix: Migrate to the installed version's field_validator or model_validator API and test behavior.

title: Model dictionary method deprecated
example_error: FastAPI Pydantic model.dict deprecation warning
explanation: The model export API changed.
likely_cause: Legacy serialization calls remain.
fix: Use model_dump with explicit options under Pydantic v2.

title: Model parse object method deprecated
example_error: FastAPI Pydantic parse_obj deprecation warning
explanation: The validation entry point changed.
likely_cause: The code uses a legacy model constructor helper.
fix: Use model_validate under Pydantic v2 and verify strictness and attribute handling.

title: ORM object requires attribute validation
example_error: FastAPI Pydantic model_validate ORM instance fails model_type
explanation: Attribute-based validation is not enabled.
likely_cause: The input is an object rather than a dictionary.
fix: Set from_attributes=True for the intended model and expose the required attributes safely.

title: Pydantic schema cannot handle arbitrary class
example_error: FastAPI PydanticSchemaGenerationError for custom service class
explanation: The type has no supported data schema.
likely_cause: An internal service object was annotated as request or response data.
fix: Keep service objects in dependencies and use serializable public models.

title: Email validation dependency absent
example_error: FastAPI EmailStr ImportError email-validator is not installed
explanation: EmailStr relies on an optional validation package.
likely_cause: The runtime dependency is missing.
fix: Install the documented Pydantic email extra or email-validator dependency and pin it.

title: Model field overrides protected method
example_error: FastAPI Pydantic model field name shadows model method
explanation: The field name conflicts with model APIs.
likely_cause: A public payload key was used directly as a Python attribute.
fix: Use a safe internal field name with an external alias.

title: Forward reference model not rebuilt
example_error: FastAPI Pydantic class not fully defined forward reference
explanation: The schema cannot resolve a referenced type.
likely_cause: The model is evaluated before its referenced definitions exist.
fix: Define referenced models and call model_rebuild when required by the installed version.

title: Mutable default configuration misunderstood
example_error: FastAPI model defaults behave differently from plain function defaults
explanation: Model default handling and Python function defaults are different mechanisms.
likely_cause: A mutable container is shared outside the model definition.
fix: Use default_factory for explicit per-instance containers and avoid shared mutable function defaults.

title: Pydantic field alias changes output names
example_error: FastAPI response JSON uses alias instead of Python field name
explanation: Response serialization follows alias configuration.
likely_cause: Client assumptions differ from the public schema.
fix: Set response alias behavior intentionally and test the exact external JSON keys.

title: Returning Response bypasses model validation
example_error: FastAPI invalid payload returned successfully through JSONResponse
explanation: Direct Response objects bypass normal model serialization.
likely_cause: The handler manually constructs the response.
fix: Validate the payload before constructing it or return ordinary data through response_model.

title: Response excludes sensitive field only in docs
example_error: FastAPI JSONResponse leaks field despite response_model exclusion
explanation: A direct response bypasses output filtering.
likely_cause: Raw internal data is serialized manually.
fix: Return a public response model or explicitly filter before creating the response.

title: Response integer outside JavaScript safe range
example_error: FastAPI large integer response loses precision in browser
explanation: JavaScript numbers cannot represent every large integer exactly.
likely_cause: An opaque large identifier is encoded as a JSON number.
fix: Represent such identifiers as strings in the public schema.

title: Response contains bytes with invalid UTF8
example_error: FastAPI serialization UnicodeDecodeError for binary payload
explanation: Arbitrary bytes are not necessarily text.
likely_cause: Binary data entered a JSON response.
fix: Use a binary Response with the proper media type or an explicit base64 field.

title: Response contains unsupported object
example_error: FastAPI jsonable_encoder fails on custom object
explanation: The value cannot be converted into the declared JSON structure.
likely_cause: A service or database object was returned directly.
fix: Map it into a serializable response model with explicit fields.

title: No-content status declared with body model
example_error: FastAPI assertion status code 204 must not have a response body
explanation: A no-content response cannot promise body data.
likely_cause: The route combines 204 with a body schema.
fix: Return an empty Response with 204 or use a status that allows the intended body.

title: FileResponse path missing
example_error: FastAPI FileResponse RuntimeError file does not exist
explanation: The file is unavailable when the response is sent.
likely_cause: The path is wrong or cleanup ran too early.
fix: Verify the path and keep the file available until delivery completes.

title: FileResponse points to directory
example_error: FastAPI FileResponse RuntimeError path is not a file
explanation: A directory cannot be served as one file.
likely_cause: Path construction resolved to a folder.
fix: Validate the intended regular file and restrict paths to the allowed directory.

title: Streaming media type prevents browser incremental display
example_error: FastAPI stream arrives buffered in browser despite incremental yields
explanation: Clients and proxies may buffer depending on protocol and headers.
likely_cause: A generic text response is used for an event stream.
fix: Use the intended streaming media type and framing, then test through the production proxy.

title: Returning tuple does not set status
example_error: FastAPI return payload, 201 produces JSON array
explanation: Flask-style response tuples are not the normal FastAPI status mechanism.
likely_cause: A tuple was returned expecting status control.
fix: Set status_code on the route or Response object and return only the intended body.

title: Depends function called during declaration
example_error: FastAPI Depends(get_db()) receives generator instead of callable
explanation: Dependencies must be passed as callables.
likely_cause: Parentheses executed the dependency at import time.
fix: Pass Depends(get_db) and let FastAPI invoke it per dependency resolution.

title: Dependency override key is wrong function
example_error: FastAPI test override has no effect and real service is called
explanation: Overrides are keyed by the original callable object.
likely_cause: The test uses a wrapper or another imported function.
fix: Override the exact callable used by the route and clear overrides after the test.

title: Dependency override not cleared between tests
example_error: FastAPI later tests keep using fake database dependency
explanation: Overrides persist on the app object.
likely_cause: A test modified dependency_overrides without cleanup.
fix: Use a fixture with finally cleanup or an isolated app factory.

title: Dependency cached unexpectedly
example_error: FastAPI repeated Depends returns same object within request
explanation: Dependency results are normally cached per request.
likely_cause: The handler expects separate evaluations.
fix: Use use_cache=False only when repeated execution is intentional.

title: Dependency executed more than intended
example_error: FastAPI expensive dependency runs repeatedly with use_cache=False
explanation: Caching was disabled.
likely_cause: Multiple dependents each trigger the work.
fix: Restore request caching or centralize the shared computation.

title: Yield dependency suppresses exception
example_error: FastAPI dependency with yield catches error and request behavior is misleading
explanation: Swallowing exceptions obscures failures.
likely_cause: The cleanup block catches an exception without re-raising or handling it meaningfully.
fix: Perform cleanup and re-raise when the request should fail.

title: Async context manager passed directly as dependency
example_error: FastAPI dependency value is AsyncGeneratorContextManager
explanation: The decorated context manager is not the dependency value itself.
likely_cause: asynccontextmanager wrapper was passed without entering it.
fix: Use an async generator dependency that enters the context and yields its resource.

title: Dependency returns coroutine from sync wrapper
example_error: FastAPI injected dependency is coroutine object
explanation: A synchronous wrapper did not await an async provider.
likely_cause: The wrapper returns the coroutine directly.
fix: Make the dependency async and await the provider.

title: Router dependency result unavailable in handler
example_error: FastAPI dependencies list runs but value is not injected
explanation: Decorator dependency lists execute checks without binding handler parameters.
likely_cause: The handler expects a returned value by name.
fix: Declare a parameter using Depends when the handler needs the result.

title: Dependency cleanup closes streaming resource early
example_error: FastAPI streaming response reads from closed dependency resource
explanation: Resource lifetime must cover stream consumption.
likely_cause: Cleanup scope or manual closing ends access too soon.
fix: Use a lifetime appropriate to the installed FastAPI version and test full stream consumption.

title: Startup handler not run with lifespan configured
example_error: FastAPI on_event startup ignored when lifespan supplied
explanation: The lifespan mechanism controls startup and shutdown.
likely_cause: Two lifecycle approaches were mixed.
fix: Move initialization and cleanup into one explicit lifespan context.

title: Lifespan missing yield
example_error: FastAPI startup: generator did not yield in lifespan
explanation: The context must hand control to the running application.
likely_cause: Initialization exits before yielding.
fix: Yield once after successful setup and place cleanup after the yield.

title: Lifespan yields more than once
example_error: FastAPI shutdown: generator did not stop in lifespan
explanation: A contextmanager must yield exactly once.
likely_cause: The lifespan contains a loop with multiple yields.
fix: Use one yield between initialization and cleanup.

title: App state accessed before initialization
example_error: FastAPI AttributeError State object has no attribute model
explanation: The resource has not been placed on app.state.
likely_cause: Startup was skipped or initialization failed.
fix: Initialize through lifespan and ensure tests and deployment execute it.

title: Model loaded separately in each worker
example_error: FastAPI memory usage multiplies with worker count
explanation: Workers are separate processes.
likely_cause: Each process loads its own model copy.
fix: Budget memory per worker and choose worker count or external serving accordingly.

title: Startup network call hangs readiness
example_error: FastAPI service never becomes ready during lifespan
explanation: Startup cannot finish while an external call waits indefinitely.
likely_cause: The initialization request has no bounded timeout.
fix: Add timeouts and a deliberate retry or unavailable-state policy.

title: Shutdown resource not awaited
example_error: FastAPI warning coroutine close was never awaited during shutdown
explanation: Async cleanup must be awaited.
likely_cause: A client close coroutine is called like a synchronous method.
fix: Await async cleanup in the lifespan finally block.

title: Mounted app lifespan not automatically invoked
example_error: FastAPI mounted application state missing startup resource
explanation: Subapplication lifecycle handling differs from the main app.
likely_cause: The mount assumes its initialization runs automatically.
fix: Coordinate resource initialization in the main lifespan or explicitly manage subapp lifecycle.

title: Development reload initializes twice
example_error: FastAPI model load logs repeat while using reload
explanation: Reloading restarts the worker process.
likely_cause: Development file watching was mistaken for one permanent process.
fix: Keep initialization idempotent and disable reload in production.

title: Artifact metadata count disagrees with vectors
example_error: FastAPI artifact loader rejects corpus vector shape mismatch
explanation: Entries and vector rows must remain aligned.
likely_cause: An artifact was assembled from different build outputs.
fix: Rebuild the dictionary atomically and validate corpus length and vector shape before deployment.

title: Blocking sleep freezes concurrent requests
example_error: FastAPI async route time.sleep delays all requests
explanation: Blocking calls occupy the event loop.
likely_cause: A synchronous sleep runs inside async code.
fix: Use await asyncio.sleep for async waiting or move blocking work to a thread.

title: Synchronous HTTP request blocks event loop
example_error: FastAPI async route requests.get stalls other clients
explanation: The synchronous network call blocks the event loop thread.
likely_cause: An async handler uses a blocking client.
fix: Use an async HTTP client or run the blocking call in a controlled thread pool.

title: CPU heavy inference stalls async server
example_error: FastAPI async endpoint CPU loop increases all latencies
explanation: Async syntax does not make CPU work nonblocking.
likely_cause: Expensive computation runs directly on the event loop.
fix: Use an appropriate worker process, job service, or bounded offloading strategy.

title: Semaphore limit multiplied across workers
example_error: FastAPI concurrency exceeds asyncio semaphore limit after adding workers
explanation: An in-memory semaphore limits one process only.
likely_cause: Each worker creates its own semaphore.
fix: Budget the total across workers or use a shared coordinator when a global limit is required.

title: Async lock created for another loop
example_error: FastAPI lock bound to a different event loop in tests
explanation: Loop-bound resources cannot be reused arbitrarily across loops.
likely_cause: A global async object survives test loop changes.
fix: Create and close the resource within the app's active lifespan loop.

title: Task result read before completion
example_error: FastAPI asyncio InvalidStateError Result is not set
explanation: The background task has not completed.
likely_cause: The handler calls task.result immediately.
fix: Await the task or design an explicit asynchronous job-status workflow.

title: Fire and forget task loses exceptions
example_error: FastAPI Task exception was never retrieved
explanation: No code awaited or inspected the task failure.
likely_cause: An unmanaged task was launched from a request.
fix: Track tasks and their errors or use a managed background job mechanism.

title: Cancellation swallowed during shutdown
example_error: FastAPI shutdown hangs after catching BaseException
explanation: Cancellation signals must be allowed to propagate after cleanup.
likely_cause: A broad catch suppresses task cancellation.
fix: Handle expected errors narrowly and re-raise cancellation after cleanup.

title: Threadpool exhausted by long sync routes
example_error: FastAPI synchronous endpoints queue under sustained load
explanation: Blocking requests consume limited worker threads.
likely_cause: Many long-lived sync operations occupy the pool.
fix: Bound work, add timeouts, and use an appropriate async or job-based design.

title: Async generator returned as ordinary JSON
example_error: FastAPI serialization cannot encode async_generator
explanation: A generator is not a completed JSON result.
likely_cause: The handler returns an async generator without a streaming response.
fix: Consume it into bounded data or wrap it in StreamingResponse with a suitable media type.

title: Middleware forgets to return response
example_error: FastAPI middleware TypeError NoneType object is not callable
explanation: The middleware chain expects a response.
likely_cause: A branch calls call_next but never returns its result.
fix: Return a valid Response from every middleware path.

title: Middleware calls next twice
example_error: FastAPI request processed twice inside middleware
explanation: Each call can execute downstream behavior.
likely_cause: The middleware invokes call_next more than once.
fix: Call it once and reuse the returned response.

title: ASGI middleware loses final request chunk
example_error: FastAPI body truncated through custom receive wrapper
explanation: ASGI request bodies may arrive in multiple messages.
likely_cause: The wrapper ignores more_body and forwards only the first chunk.
fix: Forward every message correctly or use a tested middleware abstraction.

title: Middleware order changes error headers
example_error: FastAPI error response lacks expected CORS header
explanation: Middleware order affects which responses get wrapped.
likely_cause: An error is generated outside the CORS layer.
fix: Review wrapping order and test unhandled-error responses as well as successful requests.

title: Trusted host middleware rejects deployment domain
example_error: FastAPI 400 Invalid host header
explanation: The Host header is outside the allowlist.
likely_cause: The public deployment hostname is missing.
fix: Add the exact authorized hostname to TrustedHostMiddleware configuration.

title: HTTPS redirect loops behind proxy
example_error: FastAPI repeated redirects between same HTTPS URL
explanation: The app sees proxied traffic as HTTP.
likely_cause: Forwarded scheme information is not trusted or configured correctly.
fix: Configure trusted proxy forwarding and the public scheme according to the server deployment model.

title: Request ID middleware shares global variable
example_error: FastAPI logs show another request's correlation ID
explanation: Concurrent requests overwrite shared state.
likely_cause: A module-level variable stores per-request data.
fix: Use request.state or properly scoped context variables.

title: Middleware mutates immutable headers view
example_error: FastAPI request.headers assignment TypeError
explanation: The high-level headers view is not a mutable response container.
likely_cause: Code tries to edit request headers directly.
fix: Set response.headers for outgoing values or use a correct ASGI scope wrapper when rewriting is required.

title: Response timing includes only initial stream
example_error: FastAPI middleware duration excludes full file download
explanation: Timing call_next may measure response creation rather than complete delivery.
likely_cause: A streaming response finishes later.
fix: Measure the intended lifecycle with suitable ASGI instrumentation and label metrics clearly.

title: Middleware exception converted inconsistently
example_error: FastAPI HTTPException raised in middleware becomes server error
explanation: Middleware sits outside normal route exception handling paths.
likely_cause: Route-style exception handling was assumed.
fix: Return an appropriate Response from middleware or implement handling at the correct layer.

title: CORS origin includes path
example_error: FastAPI browser blocked when allow_origins contains https://site/app
explanation: An origin contains scheme, host, and port only.
likely_cause: A page URL with a path was configured.
fix: Allow the exact origin without a path or trailing page segment.

title: CORS localhost port mismatch
example_error: FastAPI CORS works on localhost 5173 but fails on 4173
explanation: Different ports define different origins.
likely_cause: The preview server uses an unlisted port.
fix: Add the intended development origin or run the frontend at the allowed port.

title: CORS cached preflight hides policy update
example_error: FastAPI browser continues old CORS behavior after server configuration change
explanation: Browsers can cache preflight decisions.
likely_cause: A previously cached policy remains active.
fix: Retest in a fresh browser context and configure a suitable max_age for expected changes.

title: Redirected preflight fails before endpoint
example_error: FastAPI OPTIONS redirects due to wrong API base path
explanation: The request reaches a redirect instead of the intended preflight handler.
likely_cause: The frontend base URL contains an incorrect prefix or slash.
fix: Use the exact public endpoint URL and test OPTIONS without redirects.

title: CORS origin regex matches unintended domains
example_error: FastAPI CORS regex permits attacker-controlled hostname suffix
explanation: An overly broad pattern admits more origins than intended.
likely_cause: Dots or anchors are missing from the origin regex.
fix: Prefer exact allowed origins or use a carefully anchored escaped pattern with negative tests.

title: CORS preview deployment origin absent
example_error: FastAPI works on production frontend but Vercel preview is blocked
explanation: Each preview hostname is a different origin.
likely_cause: Only the production hostname is allowed.
fix: Allow selected preview origins deliberately or test against the production origin.

title: CORS does not protect server from direct requests
example_error: FastAPI nonbrowser client can call API despite CORS restrictions
explanation: CORS controls browser response access, not authentication.
likely_cause: The origin policy was treated as access control.
fix: Implement actual authentication or authorization if the API requires restricted access.

title: Mixed content blocks HTTPS frontend HTTP API
example_error: FastAPI fetch blocked as mixed content before CORS
explanation: Secure pages cannot freely call insecure active content.
likely_cause: The frontend API base uses HTTP.
fix: Deploy and configure the API with a valid HTTPS URL.

title: CORS exposed response header unavailable
example_error: FastAPI fetch response.headers cannot read custom request ID
explanation: Browsers expose only allowed response headers cross-origin.
likely_cause: The custom header is not in expose_headers.
fix: Add the intended public header to expose_headers.

title: CORS failure masks API server error
example_error: FastAPI browser reports CORS but curl shows HTTP 500
explanation: The underlying server error may lack CORS headers.
likely_cause: Only browser messaging was inspected.
fix: Fix the server exception and verify error responses receive the intended CORS policy.

title: Bearer token header omitted
example_error: FastAPI protected route reports missing bearer credentials
explanation: The security dependency cannot find a token.
likely_cause: The client did not send Authorization.
fix: Send Authorization: Bearer with a valid token using the documented flow.

title: Bearer token scheme malformed
example_error: FastAPI authentication fails for Token prefix
explanation: The security scheme expects Bearer.
likely_cause: The client uses another prefix or malformed spacing.
fix: Use the exact supported Authorization scheme and token format.

title: OAuth token request sent as JSON
example_error: FastAPI OAuth2PasswordRequestForm 422 missing username password
explanation: The dependency expects form fields.
likely_cause: The client sends a JSON object.
fix: Send form-urlencoded username and password for that contract.

title: OAuth token response field names wrong
example_error: FastAPI docs authorize succeeds request but token not applied
explanation: OAuth clients expect the documented token response shape.
likely_cause: The response omits access_token or token_type.
fix: Return the expected fields and test an authenticated request after login.

title: OAuth token URL missing proxy prefix
example_error: FastAPI Swagger authorize posts token to wrong URL
explanation: The declared token URL must resolve under the deployed base path.
likely_cause: An absolute root path ignores the proxy prefix.
fix: Use a suitable relative token URL and verify the deployed OpenAPI server path.

title: Expired token still stored in frontend
example_error: FastAPI requests return unauthorized after idle period
explanation: The credential is no longer valid.
likely_cause: The client continues sending an expired token.
fix: Handle expiration through the application's documented refresh or reauthentication flow.

title: Token audience mismatch
example_error: FastAPI token validation rejects invalid audience
explanation: The token was issued for another service.
likely_cause: The validator expects a different audience claim.
fix: Use a token issued for this API and keep audience verification enabled.

title: Token issuer mismatch
example_error: FastAPI token validation rejects invalid issuer
explanation: The issuer claim does not match the trusted authority.
likely_cause: Environment configuration points to another identity provider or tenant.
fix: Align the configured trusted issuer with the intended token authority.

title: Security scope missing
example_error: FastAPI authenticated user gets insufficient permissions
explanation: Authentication succeeded but authorization requirements are unmet.
likely_cause: The token lacks a required scope.
fix: Request or grant the appropriate scope through the authorized policy.

title: Cookie authentication not sent cross-origin
example_error: FastAPI browser session missing while same-origin request works
explanation: Cookie delivery depends on fetch credentials and cookie attributes.
likely_cause: Cross-origin credentials or cookie policy is incompatible.
fix: Configure intentional credentials, SameSite, Secure, and explicit CORS origins for the deployment.

title: Upload field name mismatch
example_error: FastAPI 422 loc body file when multipart field is upload
explanation: Multipart field names must match the public schema.
likely_cause: The client uses the wrong key.
fix: Append the file under the declared field name or alias.

title: Multipart boundary disagrees with body delimiter
example_error: FastAPI multipart parser unexpected end of stream with boundary present
explanation: The declared boundary must match the actual body framing.
likely_cause: The client manually constructs mismatched multipart bytes.
fix: Use a standard multipart encoder instead of hand-building headers and delimiters.

title: JSON and file expected in same request incorrectly
example_error: FastAPI file plus JSON body model fails validation
explanation: A request has one body encoding.
likely_cause: The endpoint mixes multipart upload with a separate JSON body expectation.
fix: Send structured metadata as a form field with explicit parsing or use separate operations.

title: Upload read not awaited
example_error: FastAPI UploadFile.read returns coroutine instead of bytes
explanation: UploadFile exposes async read methods.
likely_cause: The handler forgot await.
fix: Await file.read in async code and enforce an appropriate size limit.

title: Upload second read returns empty bytes
example_error: FastAPI UploadFile.read is empty on second call
explanation: The first read advanced the file cursor.
likely_cause: The same upload is consumed twice.
fix: Seek back to the start when rereading is intentional or reuse the bounded first result.

title: Upload closed before background processing
example_error: FastAPI background task ValueError I/O operation on closed file
explanation: Request-managed upload resources may close after the request.
likely_cause: A background task retains the UploadFile object.
fix: Persist needed bytes to a controlled temporary resource before scheduling and clean up afterward.

title: Upload filename used as unrestricted path
example_error: FastAPI uploaded filename writes outside intended directory
explanation: Client-supplied names are untrusted path data.
likely_cause: The handler joins the raw filename to a storage path.
fix: Generate a server-side name and verify the resolved path stays inside the approved directory.

title: Upload content type trusted without inspection
example_error: FastAPI image processing fails despite image content type
explanation: The header is a client claim, not content validation.
likely_cause: A nonimage file was labeled as an image.
fix: Validate actual content using a suitable parser and enforce resource limits.

title: Upload memory usage spikes
example_error: FastAPI await file.read consumes too much memory
explanation: Reading the whole upload materializes its bytes.
likely_cause: Large files are accepted without bounded processing.
fix: Apply request size limits and process bounded chunks when uploads are required.

title: Multipart parser package conflict
example_error: FastAPI form parsing fails with wrong multipart package installed
explanation: Similarly named distributions can provide conflicting modules.
likely_cause: The unrelated multipart package shadows python-multipart.
fix: Use the documented python-multipart dependency in a clean environment.

title: BackgroundTasks parameter wrapped in Depends
example_error: FastAPI assertion Cannot specify Depends for BackgroundTasks
explanation: FastAPI injects this special type directly.
likely_cause: The parameter incorrectly uses Depends.
fix: Declare BackgroundTasks as a parameter without wrapping it in Depends.

title: Background task invoked immediately
example_error: FastAPI add_task runs work before response
explanation: The function was called while registering the task.
likely_cause: Parentheses pass its return value instead of the callable.
fix: Use add_task(function, arguments) without executing the function first.

title: Background task failure lacks request correlation
example_error: FastAPI background error log cannot be tied to originating request
explanation: Request context may be gone when the task runs.
likely_cause: No stable correlation identifier was passed.
fix: Pass a safe request or job identifier explicitly and record task status without request body content.

title: Background tasks lost on process restart
example_error: FastAPI queued background work disappears after deployment
explanation: In-process tasks are not durable jobs.
likely_cause: The worker exits before execution completes.
fix: Use a durable queue for work that must survive restarts.

title: Background tasks run sequentially
example_error: FastAPI second BackgroundTasks function waits for first
explanation: Registered tasks may execute in order.
likely_cause: Parallel execution was assumed.
fix: Use an explicitly managed concurrent workflow when needed and handle failures deliberately.

title: Async background task blocks event loop
example_error: FastAPI background async function performs CPU work and stalls API
explanation: Async background functions still execute on the event loop.
likely_cause: CPU-heavy work is not offloaded.
fix: Move heavy jobs to an appropriate worker process or job system.

title: Background task reuses closed database session
example_error: FastAPI background operation raises session closed error
explanation: Request-scoped resources do not guarantee task lifetime.
likely_cause: The task receives the handler's database session.
fix: Open and close a task-owned session inside the background operation.

title: Background task captures mutable request data
example_error: FastAPI background job sees changed list contents
explanation: Closures and arguments can reference mutable objects.
likely_cause: The shared object is modified before task use.
fix: Pass an immutable snapshot of the required validated data.

title: Client retries schedule duplicate background work
example_error: FastAPI repeated POST creates duplicate jobs
explanation: A retried request can be processed more than once.
likely_cause: The operation lacks idempotency handling.
fix: Use an appropriate idempotency key and durable job identity for side-effecting work.

title: Background task never added to returned custom response
example_error: FastAPI manually built Response omits expected background work
explanation: The response must carry the intended background execution.
likely_cause: Custom response construction discards the task attachment.
