fix: Attach the BackgroundTasks object to the Response or use normal framework response handling.

title: WebSocket subprotocol negotiation mismatch
example_error: FastAPI browser closes socket because requested subprotocol not selected
explanation: Client and server disagree on the negotiated protocol.
likely_cause: The accept call omits or selects an unsupported subprotocol.
fix: Choose a supported offered subprotocol and validate the application protocol before messaging.

title: Concurrent WebSocket receive calls race
example_error: FastAPI WebSocket messages consumed by wrong coroutine
explanation: Multiple readers compete for one incoming stream.
likely_cause: Two tasks call receive on the same connection.
fix: Use one receiver and dispatch validated messages to internal consumers.

title: WebSocket JSON parser receives plain text
example_error: FastAPI websocket.receive_json raises JSONDecodeError
explanation: The message is not valid JSON.
likely_cause: Client and server disagree on message format.
fix: Send valid JSON or receive text and validate an explicit protocol.

title: WebSocket binary sent to text handler
example_error: FastAPI websocket.receive_text fails on binary message
explanation: The handler expects a text frame.
likely_cause: The client sends binary frames.
fix: Use matching receive_bytes behavior or enforce a documented frame type.

title: WebSocket proxy does not forward upgrade
example_error: FastAPI WebSocket works locally but proxy returns 400
explanation: The proxy must support WebSocket upgrade forwarding.
likely_cause: Deployment proxy configuration handles only ordinary HTTP.
fix: Enable the platform's WebSocket support and verify upgrade headers and timeouts.

title: WebSocket uses insecure ws from HTTPS page
example_error: FastAPI browser blocks ws connection as insecure
explanation: Secure pages require an appropriate secure socket connection.
likely_cause: The frontend constructs ws instead of wss.
fix: Use wss for the HTTPS deployment.

title: WebSocket broadcast stops on stale client
example_error: FastAPI broadcast raises when one connection is closed
explanation: A disconnected socket remains in the connection list.
likely_cause: Broadcast assumes every client is active.
fix: Remove disconnected clients and handle per-client send failures.

title: WebSocket connection registry differs across workers
example_error: FastAPI broadcast reaches only some connected users
explanation: In-memory registries are process-local.
likely_cause: Clients connect to different server workers.
fix: Use a shared messaging layer for cross-worker broadcasts.

title: WebSocket token query leaks in logs
example_error: FastAPI WebSocket URL contains bearer token in access logs
explanation: URL query values may be recorded by infrastructure.
likely_cause: A long-lived secret is passed in the connection URL.
fix: Use a reviewed authentication design and avoid logging or persisting sensitive connection parameters.

title: WebSocket idle connection closed by infrastructure
example_error: FastAPI WebSocket disconnects after fixed idle duration
explanation: Proxies may enforce idle timeouts.
likely_cause: No traffic keeps the connection active.
fix: Configure supported heartbeat behavior and reconnect logic consistent with the platform limits.

title: TestClient startup not executed
example_error: FastAPI tests missing app.state resource without TestClient context
explanation: Lifecycle setup requires the appropriate test lifecycle.
likely_cause: The client was not used as a context manager.
fix: Use with TestClient(app) to run startup and shutdown around the test.

title: Async HTTP client does not run lifespan automatically
example_error: FastAPI ASGITransport tests fail before model initialization
explanation: Transport calls alone do not necessarily manage application lifespan.
likely_cause: The test assumes startup is automatic.
fix: Manage lifespan explicitly in the async test fixture.

title: TestClient raises server exception instead of returning 500
example_error: FastAPI test cannot inspect 500 response because exception is raised
explanation: The test client surfaces server exceptions by default.
likely_cause: The test expects production-style response inspection.
fix: Use raise_server_exceptions=False for the specific error-response test.

title: Async test missing async test plugin
example_error: FastAPI pytest async test is not natively supported
explanation: Pytest needs a supported async execution integration.
likely_cause: The test environment lacks configuration or plugin support.
fix: Install and configure the chosen async test plugin and mark tests accordingly.

title: Test uses await on synchronous TestClient
example_error: FastAPI test TypeError Response cannot be used in await expression
explanation: TestClient methods are synchronous.
likely_cause: Sync and async client APIs were mixed.
fix: Use TestClient without await or an AsyncClient with a suitable ASGI transport.

title: HTTPX client app argument removed
example_error: FastAPI tests TypeError Client.__init__ unexpected keyword argument app
explanation: Client and framework versions use incompatible integration APIs.
likely_cause: An old test pattern or mismatched dependency remains.
fix: Use compatible pinned versions and the documented ASGI transport interface.

title: Database rollback fixture does not isolate background work
example_error: FastAPI test data persists after rollback fixture
explanation: Background work may use another connection or transaction.
likely_cause: The fixture only controls the request transaction.
fix: Design task-aware test isolation and clean up all participating resources.

title: Test dependency mock returns wrong type
example_error: FastAPI test response validation fails only with override
explanation: The fake does not satisfy the dependency contract.
likely_cause: The mock returns a simplified incompatible object.
fix: Return realistic typed data from the override and validate the fixture itself.

title: Route test follows redirect hides slash bug
example_error: FastAPI test passes but production client receives redirect
explanation: The test client automatically follows redirects.
likely_cause: The assertion checks only the final status.
fix: Disable redirect following for a test of the exact registered URL.

title: Concurrent tests share mutable application state
example_error: FastAPI test results depend on execution order
explanation: Tests mutate one shared app or resource.
likely_cause: Overrides and state leak between cases.
fix: Use isolated app fixtures and deterministic cleanup of shared resources.

title: Application object shadowed by imported module
example_error: FastAPI ASGI target app resolves to module object not callable
explanation: The exported name no longer refers to the application.
likely_cause: A later import overwrote the app variable.
fix: Use distinct names and verify the exact module attribute passed to the server.

title: Server binds only loopback in container
example_error: FastAPI container runs but public port is unreachable
explanation: Loopback binding is accessible only inside the container.
likely_cause: The server listens on 127.0.0.1.
fix: Bind to the platform-required interface, commonly 0.0.0.0, and expose the correct port.

title: Platform port environment ignored
example_error: FastAPI deployment health check cannot connect to expected port
explanation: The platform routes traffic to its configured port.
likely_cause: The server listens on a hardcoded different port.
fix: Read and use the deployment's required port setting.

title: Proxy path prefix breaks OpenAPI docs
example_error: FastAPI docs load but schema URL returns 404 behind prefix
explanation: Generated URLs need the external root path.
likely_cause: The app is served under a prefix not reflected in configuration.
fix: Set root_path and proxy routing consistently and test the public docs URL.

title: Static files directory missing at startup
example_error: FastAPI StaticFiles RuntimeError Directory static does not exist
explanation: The configured asset directory is unavailable.
likely_cause: The build omitted files or uses a different working directory.
fix: Package the assets and resolve paths relative to a known application location.

title: Environment variable absent in deployed function
example_error: FastAPI startup KeyError for required configuration
explanation: The deployment lacks a required setting.
likely_cause: A local .env was assumed to transfer automatically.
fix: Configure the value through the platform's environment or secret mechanism.

title: Artifact class cannot import after deployment
example_error: FastAPI joblib load ModuleNotFoundError pipeline_def
explanation: Pickled custom classes need their importable module.
likely_cause: The deployment includes the artifact but omits its class definition.
fix: Package pipeline_def.py under the same import path as at build time.

title: Artifact sklearn version mismatch at startup
example_error: FastAPI model unavailable after InconsistentVersionWarning
explanation: Serialized estimators may be incompatible across versions.
likely_cause: The runtime sklearn version differs from artifact metadata.
fix: Pin the exact build version or rebuild and verify the artifact for the intended runtime.

title: Readiness checks wrong worker after partial initialization
example_error: FastAPI intermittent 503 only on some requests after deployment
explanation: Workers maintain independent initialization state.
likely_cause: Some workers failed loading while others became ready.
fix: Validate initialization per worker and surface failures before accepting traffic.

title: Frontend build uses stale API base URL
example_error: FastAPI new deployment works directly but frontend calls old host
explanation: Vite embeds configured values during the frontend build.
likely_cause: The environment was changed without rebuilding production assets.
fix: Set VITE_API_BASE_URL for the correct deployment environment and rebuild the frontend.

title: Search endpoint accidentally refits vectorizer
example_error: FastAPI similarity changes between identical requests
explanation: Refitting changes vocabulary and IDF weights.
likely_cause: The handler calls fit_transform on query data.
fix: Load the fitted artifact once and call transform only; test vocabulary and IDF stability.

title: Unknown query returns arbitrary first result
example_error: FastAPI search returns unrelated match for zero vocabulary vector
explanation: All cosine scores are zero for an unrepresented query.
likely_cause: Ranking slices the sorted list without checking vector content.
fix: Detect a zero-vector query and return an explicit empty no-match result.

title: Similarity displayed as confidence
example_error: FastAPI search UI labels cosine score as probability
explanation: Text similarity is not calibrated diagnostic confidence.
likely_cause: The frontend mislabels the ranking score.
fix: Label scores as similarity and explain that results are candidate explanations.

title: Request validation logs raw sensitive input
example_error: FastAPI 422 response or logs echo pasted traceback secrets
explanation: Validation details may include the original input.
likely_cause: Default error serialization or request logging preserves content.
fix: Omit input values from validation responses and avoid application-level body logging.

title: Health endpoint serializes exception details
example_error: FastAPI readiness 503 exposes local file paths
explanation: Internal load errors contain implementation details.
likely_cause: The endpoint returns the raw exception text.
fix: Return a concise unavailable message and keep operational diagnostics in controlled logs.

title: Rate of requests exceeds worker capacity
example_error: FastAPI latency grows while CPU or concurrency limit is saturated
explanation: Requests arrive faster than the service completes them.
likely_cause: Capacity or per-request work is insufficiently bounded.
fix: Measure bottlenecks, bound request work, and configure appropriate capacity and overload behavior.

title: Client timeout shorter than cold start
example_error: FastAPI first fetch aborts but retry succeeds
explanation: The server may need time to start and load resources.
likely_cause: The client deadline is shorter than measured startup.
fix: Set a reasonable bounded timeout and show a clear starting or unavailable state.

title: Exception handler has wrong signature
example_error: FastAPI custom exception handler TypeError positional arguments mismatch
explanation: The handler receives both request and exception arguments.
likely_cause: The registered callable accepts only one parameter.
fix: Use the documented request and exception signature and return a valid Response.

title: Metrics include user error text as label
example_error: FastAPI monitoring cardinality explodes after labeling by traceback
explanation: Each distinct input creates a new metric series.
likely_cause: Unbounded user text is used as a metric label.
fix: Use bounded categories such as status and route, without storing pasted content.

title: Search top k boolean accepted unintentionally
example_error: FastAPI top_k=true accepted as integer in permissive validation
explanation: Boolean values can be coerced under permissive integer rules.
likely_cause: The request model lacks strict integer validation.
fix: Use a strict constrained integer and test booleans, strings, floats, and bounds.
